question: After growing bored while guarding his master's traumatized younger sister, this character binge-watched Korean period dramas and picked up an old-fashioned way of speaking. When Hwang Dongsoo nearly killed Yoo Jinho, this character was swapped in through Shadow Exchange and healed Jinho from the brink of death. His master named him after the French novelist Bernard Werber, author of Empire of the Ants. In his earlier form, he gained speech and healing magic by using his Gluttony ability to devour the head of the S-rank healer Min Byung-gyu. That form was the hidden boss of the Jeju Island S-rank gate, where it killed Goto Ryuji, the strongest hunter in Japan. For 10 points, name this Marshal-grade insect shadow that Sung Jinwoo extracted from the slain Ant King in Solo Leveling.
answer: Beru [do not accept or prompt on “Ant King”]

question: This character's guildmates nicknamed her “The Dancer” for her fluid sword movements, a name she found so embarrassing that she banned it. On her day off, she borrowed a miner's pickaxe to follow a supposedly E-rank porter into an A-rank gate full of high orcs. Her skills include Sword Dance and Sword of Light, and she later trains at the kumdo school of Song Chi-yul. During the Jeju Island raid, she beheaded the Ant Queen but was knocked unconscious by a single punch from the Ant King. Han So-hee was cast to play this vice-guild master of the Hunters Guild, Korea's only female S-rank hunter, in a Netflix live-action series. For 10 points, name this Solo Leveling swordswoman whose sensitivity to mana makes every hunter smell foul to her except Sung Jinwoo.
answer: Cha Hae-in [or Hae-in; accept Cha Haein or Haein; accept Shizuku Kosaka or Kousaka Shizuku]

question: In this place's final trial, a blue ring of flames counted down the minutes while a red ring tracked how many people still stood on the central altar. Its designer, the Architect Kandiaru, invited the protagonist back once he reached level 100. Only six of the seventeen hunters who entered it the first time were still alive when its doors finally opened. Statues holding instruments began to play once each survivor stood before one, while anyone standing too tall was killed by the Statue of God's heat vision. A runic stone tablet here ordered visitors to worship god, praise god, and prove their faith, warning that the disobedient would not be spared. For 10 points, name this hidden area inside a D-rank gate where Sung Jinwoo, pinned to an altar by a statue's spear, accepts the System's offer to become its Player.
answer: the Double Dungeon [or Cartenon Temple; accept Temple of Cartenon]

question: This writer debuted in 2015 with an eight-volume fantasy novel about a gifted knight aspirant who, no longer able to wield a sword, receives a strange diary. This writer's pen name comes from the hanja for a clear, high autumn sky. Speaking to the Russian platform LitRes, this writer named a favorite scene: the hero weeping as he tells his newly awakened mother how hard life had been. In a LitRes interview, this writer also called the Daul-written sequel Ragnarok a spin-off made for fanservice rather than a direct continuation. This writer returned to script a 2023 side-story webtoon, drawn by a new art team after the 2022 death of illustrator Dubu. For 10 points, name this South Korean web novelist who created the E-rank hunter Sung Jinwoo in Solo Leveling.

Before the apocalypse, this 28-year-old worked in quality assurance at the game company Minosoft. His mother preferred to write his given name with a hanja meaning “reader”, while his father favored one meaning “alone”. He angrily called out Han Sooyoung's novel “SSSSS-grade Infinite Regressor” as a plagiarism of his favorite story. This character's modifier is “Demon King of Salvation”, and he once disguised himself as a removal slave in the 73rd Demon Realm. Ahn Hyo-seop played him in a 2025 film whose changes, such as turning Jisoo's sword-wielding character into a sniper, sparked fan backlash. For 10 points, name this protagonist of Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint, the only person to read Three Ways to Survive in a Ruined World all the way to its end.

Namgung Minyoung taught this character Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship, and his Sage's Eye skill makes his right eye glow gold. Under the alias “Punisher”, he takes a female form said to be three times as beautiful as his usual one. A former pro gamer, he holds an attribute from that career which evolves into Ruler of Amusement. His reader-turned-companion often mocks him as a sunfish, after a game whose fragile fish dies from almost anything and must constantly start over. His stigmas Regression and Transmission send him back to the start of the scenarios with his memories and let him slowly regain lost skills. For 10 points, name this character played by Lee Min-ho, the protagonist of the novel-within-a-novel Three Ways to Survive in a Ruined World.
answer: Yoo Joonghyuk [or Joonghyuk; accept Yu Junghyeok, Junghyeok, Yoo Jonghyuk, Yoo Joong-hyuk, Joong-hyuk, or YJH]

question: Lacking enough probability, these beings may appear in symbolic bodies, such as a goblet of wine for Dionysus or a 100-won coin for Yi Sunsin. From lowest to highest, they are ranked as Historical figure grade, Narrative grade, and Myth grade. An incarnation joins their ranks after gaining five Stories of at least Legendary grade, receiving a modifier such as “Demon-like Judge of Fire”. They band together in nebulae such as Olympus, Eden, and Asgard, and each indirect message they send to a channel costs 200 coins. Through sponsor contracts, they grant stigmas to the incarnations they favor and take responsibility for their actions. For 10 points, name these mythic and historical beings, such as Uriel and Sun Wukong, who watch and sponsor incarnations in Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint.

The earliest known record of these beings is the Silla-era tale “Lady Dohwa and Bachelor Bihyeong”, preserved in the Memorabilia of the Three Kingdoms. Folklore says they challenge travelers to ssireum wrestling matches and own a magic club, the bangmangi, that can summon things. In a hit apocalypse web novel, they are ranked from Low-grade up to Great-grade, with higher ranks taking more humanlike forms. In that novel, each keeps a private room named after the gamtu, a hat they sometimes wear in folktales, where it hides its true form. One of them, Bihyung, invented the Random Item Box and livestreams the protagonist's early scenarios for coin donations. For 10 points, name these creatures of Korean folklore, one of which appears on a subway at seven in the evening to announce the first scenario in Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint.

After their serial How to Become a Star Writer was cancelled, one half of this team broke the other's slump by typing three lines about a man's name. One member of this team had wanted since around 2012 to write “a story about stories”, a theme tested in earlier, cruder attempts. Their debut novel, The World After the Fall, follows Jae-hwan as he conquers a tower of 100 levels, and it became a webtoon in 2022. In a 2020 afterword, this pen name was revealed to belong not to one person but to a married couple. The duo cautiously endorsed a 2025 live-action film of their best-known work, saying that adapting it carried significant risks. For 10 points, give this pen name used by the authors of Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint.
answer: singNsong [or Sing Shong; accept sing N song, Sing N Shong, SingShong, Sing-Shong, Sing Song, Sing-Syong, or 싱숑]

question: Po Bidau Gustang, head of one of the Ten Great Families, first studied this substance systematically, and the terms used to measure it come from his work. A person's control of it is rated in Baang, the basic unit, Myun, a unit's surface area, and Soo, its concentration. Enryu reportedly handled over 9,000 Baang of it, and his killing of the 43rd Floor's Administrator made that floor the only place it can be freely used without a contract. Elsewhere, Regulars need a contract with a floor's Administrator to control it directly, a restriction from which Irregulars are exempt. Twenty-Fifth Bam's favored technique, flow control, rides its temporary currents, and it grows denser on higher floors until it flows like water. For 10 points, name this “divine water” that permeates the Tower in Tower of God, taking the place of air for the Tower's inhabitants.

With Evan Edrok's help, this character learned Enna Core, a rare Light Bearer skill, and his power takes the extremely rare shape of an Ice Spear. After a disguised rival hid a bomb in him on the Hidden Floor, he froze his own innards, staying comatose until struck by a hammer forged in Yeon family flame. He was expelled from his family after his older sister failed to become a Princess of Jahad, and he once raided his father Eduan's treasure room. His name references an Argentine former footballer, reflecting his creator's love of the sport. On the Floor of Test, he was named a Best Seed of the Light Bearer group in the Position Test. For 10 points, name this cunning, blue-haired Light Bearer who becomes Twenty-Fifth Bam's best friend alongside Rak in Tower of God.
answer: Khun Aguero Agnes [or Aguero; or Agero; or Agnes; or Agnis; or Koon; or Kun]

question: After her group saved Hoaqin, the soul-devouring White, this character demanded that he serve as her subordinate and faithful sword. When Edin Dan refused her request that he become her legs, she stabbed his legs in a rage. In the 2020 anime adaptation, this character is voiced by Saori Hayami in Japanese. After Ho stabbed her in the leg during the Hide-and-Seek test, she pretended to be crippled, and Bam vowed to be her legs. At the end of the Last Examination on the Floor of Test, she suddenly stood up and pushed Bam out of a protective bubble, telling him he had to die there. For 10 points, name this girl who visited Bam in his cave, whom he follows into the Tower of God because she longs to see the stars.

This creator describes his signature series as merely one part of a far larger setting called the Talse Uzer Story, whose history can never be changed. In 2025 he made his first appearance at a United States event, signing for fans at Anime Expo. After majoring in art education, he filled ten sketchbooks with ideas for his hit series during his mandatory military service. He posted that series in an amateur Challenge League section for over six months before its official serialization began on June 30, 2010. He is known for naming characters after football players and fish, and he regularly blogs biographies of minor characters. For 10 points, name this pen-named Korean creator of Tower of God.
answer: SIU [or Slave In Utero; or Lee Jong-hui; or Lee Jong-hwi]

question: Wearing a fox mask, this character infiltrated the Workers as an executive called Kitsune, and he later founded the crew Allied to bring them down. A diet under Sophia Alexander took 50 kilograms off his original body. His great talent is copying techniques after seeing them, and in Ultra-Instinct the colors of his eyes invert to black sclera and white pupils. He transferred to J High School to escape bullying by Logan Lee, and he works nights at a local mart in his original body. Studio Mir adapted his story into a 2022 Netflix animated series. For 10 points, name this protagonist of Lookism, a bullied teen who switches between his original body and a tall, handsome second body by falling asleep.
answer: Park Hyung-seok [or Hyungseok; or Hyung Seok; or Hyung Suk; or Daniel Park; accept Keisuke Hasegawa]

question: Among the yakuza this fighter is called the White Ghost, and he is also known as the Training Genius for his skill at developing fighters. Born with black eyes and congenital Ultra-Instinct, he is a son of Shingen Yamazaki and lost both parents to his uncle Shintaro. He learned the whole of Kyokushin from Ryuzo Magami within a month. After he crossed to Korea, Gapryong Kim got him into Juvenile Prison, where the janitor Charles Choi begged to work with him. With his rival Goo Kim, who left the scar through his left brow, he built the Four Major Crews for Charles Choi. For 10 points, name this glasses-wearing, results-obsessed Lookism fighter who leads the Yamazaki Syndicate and once served as Crystal Choi's bodyguard.
answer: Gun Park [or Park Jong-gun; or Jonggun; or Jong Gun; or Park Jong-geon]

question: In this webtoon, the rooster-masked fighter whose online videos guide the hero is a former elite-squad legend and the father of Gaeul. The hero is first humiliated at school by Ppakgo, a NewTuber with 700,000 subscribers, and his cameraman Snapper. A scuffle between the hero and Snapper is accidentally streamed and draws 11 million views overnight, after which the two team up. Okuruto Noboru animated it for Fuji TV's +Ultra block in 2024, and a Japanese live-action Netflix series followed in June 2026. Kim Junghyun illustrates this webtoon written by Lookism creator Taejun Pak, which began in November 2019. For 10 points, name this webtoon about bullied Yoo Ho-bin, who starts a NewTube fighting channel to pay for his mother's cancer treatment.
answer: Viral Hit [or How to Fight; or Ssaumdokhak; or Kenka Dokugaku]

question: In the series' final part, this character hides behind a shapeshifted, teal-haired disguise while paying for his sick younger sister's medicine. He scorns Charyeok, or borrowed power, and later uses his kicks to steer his staff Yeoui in original techniques such as Railgun. In the regional tournament, he knocked out the straitjacketed thug Gang Manseok, who was torturing Go Gamdo. Alongside swordswoman Yu Mira and karateka Han Daewi, he later recovers memories of his true divine identity and summons the Ruyi Jingu staff. MAPPA adapted his story into a 2020 Crunchyroll Original anime. For 10 points, name this happy-go-lucky Renewal Taekwondo user from Seoul, the protagonist of Yongje Park's The God of High School.
answer: Jin Mori [or Mori Jin; or Jin Mo-ri; prompt on Sun Wukong or Monkey King]

question: A silver cross earring from the previous Lord seals this character's power, and his only true friend was the werewolf leader Muzaka. Each use of his power drains his life force, and his Blood Field conjures blood from thin air and whips it into a storm. He adores ramen, believing it grows if left to wait, and at first does not even know how to open a door. His special title makes him the hidden protector, judge and, if necessary, executioner of the Nobles of Lukedonia. He wakes from an 820-year slumber in a casket and enrolls at Ye Ran High School, whose principal is his devoted servant. For 10 points, name this red-eyed Noble, the protagonist of Son Je-ho and Lee Kwangsu's webtoon Noblesse.
answer: Cadis Etrama Di Raizel [or Rai; do not accept or prompt on “Noblesse”]

question: This character's child apprentice Tesamu had secretly been sent by humans to spy on him, a memory stirred when Urokai hands him Tesamu's pendant. The Union built the cursed Dark Spear from his stolen research journals, and when he wields it the weapon threatens to consume him. He gained his power by experimenting on himself, and human legends of mad scientists seeking eternal life are said to trace back to him. He obsessively keeps his house tidy and runs experiments to create the perfect ramen for his master. The founder and principal of Ye Ran High School, he has served his master for over 820 years and later becomes the RK-5's Number 0. For 10 points, name this blond scientist, the devoted servant of the Noblesse, who shares his name with the young scientist of Mary Shelley's 1818 Gothic novel.

This character once sent challenge letters so clumsy that they read like love confessions, and Gestella, who took hers at face value, later blocked his Divine Judgment. He is called the “Top Ten Slayer” after he killed Astra and defeated Andrei of Frame to officially join the world's Top Ten. Before the story begins, three rankers named Greg, Mioru and Garas ambush him, yet he still manages to take one of Mioru's legs. Entirely self-taught, he invented his own electric force control, which he has passed on to only a single apprentice. At the start of the series, this gravely wounded, lightning-wielding Awakener hides from his pursuers by transforming into a fat orange tabby cat. For 10 points, name this talking cat who becomes the mentor of Jiwoo Seo in the webtoon Eleceed.

In this series, a student website for Yeongdeungpo called the Shuttle Patch ranks local fighters and dubs its protagonist “Eunjang's White Mamba”. Its antagonists include the Union, a coalition of delinquents from five schools founded by Donald Na, whose members include the impulsive Wolf Keum. Its protagonist was expelled from Byuksan Middle School after avenging his best friend Stephen Ahn, who had fallen from the school rooftop into a coma. A live-action adaptation screened its first three episodes at the 27th Busan International Film Festival before premiering on Wavve in November 2022. Park Ji-hoon won Best New Actor at the Blue Dragon Series Awards for that adaptation, whose second season arrived on Netflix in April 2025. For 10 points, name this Seopass and Razen webtoon about the small but calculating student Gray Yeon, known in Korean as Yeon Si-eun.
answer: Weak Hero [or Yakhan Yeongung; accept Weak Hero Class 1 or Weak Hero Class 2]

question: Using the handle BLLK, this story's protagonist wins a preview ticket for the fictional anime Maria from the Sky, whose knight Ryan his monster form later resembles. Former police detective Wook Pyeon, often mistaken for a thug, helps the survivors discover that the creatures only die for good when burned. Written by Kim Carnby and drawn by Hwang Young-chan, this webtoon ran from 2017 to 2020 and was followed by a prequel titled Shotgun Boy. In it, residents turn into monsters shaped by their deepest desires, while a withdrawn 18-year-old who is half-monster himself fights alongside his neighbors. Its live-action adaptation became the first South Korean series to enter Netflix's Top 10 in the United States, peaking at third place. For 10 points, name this webtoon set in the Green Roof apartment building, adapted by director Lee Eung-bok into a series starring Song Kang as Cha Hyun-su.

In this series' prologue, the protagonist quizzes his tutor about three dates from the previous year, when his father left on business trips and women in the area went missing. In 2016, a parent filed complaints against its writer under the Youth Protection Act over its all-ages rating, and it was then re-rated as adults-only. Manny Kim, the school's top dog, starts out tormenting the protagonist of this series but grows into his closest friend. The protagonist falls for Kyun Yoon, a transfer student who called an ambulance for him after a beating, and she soon becomes his father's next target. Its villain, Dongsoo Seon, is the head of G Corporation and a businessman widely admired for his volunteer work. For 10 points, name this 2014–2016 thriller webtoon about Jin Seon, a frail boy whose father is secretly a serial killer.

To fix his weak qi, this series' protagonist swallows the One Moon Divine Pill and studies the Black Heaven and Earth Techniques. His teacher won the title Nine Arts Dragon at a tournament, after which the Martial Arts Alliance spitefully killed the teacher's own master, Unwol. To shield his pupil from revenge, the teacher publicly disowns him and destroys his qi center, and Sosul then names the boy head of the Sunwoo Clan. A sequel serialized online on Daum from 2010 to 2015 has Sera Kang help rebuild that qi center. Written by Jeon Geuk-jin and drawn by Park Jin-hwan, the original ran in Daewon's Young Champ magazine from 2007 to 2010. For 10 points, name this manhwa in which the bullied student Shiwoon Yi is trained by the mysterious martial artist Chunwoo Han.
answer: The Breaker [or Beureikeo; accept The Breaker New Waves or The Breaker Eternal Force]

question: After losing a race in which the loser's bike is smashed with a sledgehammer, this series' hero travels to Osaka seeking the frame-builder Shimano Kawasaki. The protagonist copies the “lean in” cornering technique of Owen Knight, the genius leader of the Light Cavalry Crew. Its hero rides for the Hummingbird Crew alongside sprinter Dom Kang and English rider Shelly Scott in the League of Streets. Inspired by his uncle, the professional cyclist Jo Ma-hyeon, the protagonist earns the fan nickname “Super Rookie” while riding fixed-gear bikes. In July 2025, its creator admitted that some scenes drawn from reference material were nearly identical to other works, so the series was ended and refunds were offered. For 10 points, name this Yongseok Jo cycling webtoon about Jay Jo, which shares its title with Satoru Nii's 2021 Japanese manga.

In this series, the untalented but tireless Japanese champion Takeda Yuto, raised by his coach Misaki, suffers a career-ending shattered jaw against the protagonist. Early on, the arrogant prodigy Ryu Baeksan suffers the first defeat of his life at the protagonist's hands. A trainer tests the protagonist with a surprise punch from behind and concludes that the boy lives in his own “dimension of time”. Yen Press publishes it in English under the Ize Press imprint, and the Korean studio Xtorm was announced to animate a 12-episode adaptation. Its apathetic protagonist, found standing still while bullies beat him, is recruited by a legendary coach who has raised five world champions. For 10 points, name this JH webtoon about the trainer K and his emotionless prodigy Yu.

This series' hero combines his Gambler class with the personal trait Absolute Luck, though that class also wipes his stats whenever he dies. Its King of Yopy Land, who keeps an uneasy armistice with the Giga Empire, is named after Lee Doo-yeop, the creator of Taoist Land. In the real world, its protagonist's gambling debts trap him in loan shark Chairman Kim's workshop, where he is forced to play to repay them. In November 2025, Warner Bros. Animation named it among the first titles in a planned ten-series co-production deal, alongside The Stellar Swordmaster. Once the sole owner of the Golden Armor, the top-ranked protagonist is killed by a mysterious assassin during an SS-class quest and reset to the very start. For 10 points, name this Kim Sehoon webtoon about Ethan Gong, the former number-one player of the dream-accessed game Lucid Adventure.

This series' protagonist was designated 001 among “the Numbers”, the 40 survivors of a thousand-person training camp run by a private military company. After defecting, he fought under the code name Jin until he rescued South Korean officer Kang Hamchan, who traced his family and helped him retire. Back in Seoul, he works part-time on the SW Group's bodyguard team alongside his classmate Koh Sukjoo. It topped LINE Manga's annual rankings in Japan in both 2023 and 2024, and an anime adaptation was announced in June 2025. Orphaned by a plane crash as a young child, its protagonist spent a decade as a child soldier for hire before rejoining his sister and grandfather in Korea. For 10 points, name this YC and Rakhyun webtoon about Yu Ijin, who must survive his final year of high school.

In the novel Knight of Blood and Iron, this character is a throwaway hooligan who ends up a beggar and drinks himself to death after his family is ruined. He keeps Queen Alicia from becoming a tyrant by purging poison from her body, sparing the arm she severs in that novel's original plot. His first creature from a random summoning game is Ppodong, a hamster that grows more than thirty feet tall after eating a red sunflower seed. His loyal knight Javier Asrahan, the hero of the original novel, is constantly mistaken for the nobleman in place of this plain-faced man. A broke Korean civil engineering student falls asleep reading a fantasy novel and wakes up as this drunken noble, whose household is buried in debt. For 10 points, name this protagonist of The Greatest Estate Developer.

This character earns his first ancient power, the Indestructible Shield, by feeding stacks of bread to a blackened tree tied to a gluttonous priestess. He later gains the Vitality of the Heart inside a cave tornado near Puzzle City and the Sound of the Wind by blowing up a giant whirlpool. He coughs up blood after using his silver shield to stop a suicide bomber during a terror attack on the Plaza of Glory in the capital. In the novel The Birth of a Hero, this character is a minor villain who gets a brutal beating from the soon-to-be hero Choi Han. A 36-year-old Korean man whose life motto is to avoid getting beaten up wakes in the body of this red-haired, trashy eldest son of a count. For 10 points, name this protagonist of Trash of the Count's Family, also known as Lout of Count's Family.

Tested in a dream during his first growth phase, this character flees an unbeatable foe into the outer sky, shattering his plate and awakening the time attribute “The Present”. He stockpiles apple pies and hands tear-soaked slices to his guardian whenever that man overuses his powers or gets hurt. His name, inspired by a book of pure Korean words, is said to mean “joyful dragon”, chosen in the hope that he would live happily. He spent his first four years chained in a cave and tortured by Marquis Stan's son Venion, until the protagonist cut his mana-restriction chain. He appoints himself bodyguard to the red-haired protagonist of his series, whom he usually calls “weak human”. For 10 points, name this baby black dragon of Trash of the Count's Family.

Mages in this series rank their mana cores by color, purifying from black through red, orange and yellow toward silver and white. Its hero adventures with the Twin Horns party and bonds with Sylvie, the daughter of a dragon who gave her life to protect him. War brews between the continent of Dicathen and the Vritra, a clan of banished deities who rule a faraway land. Studio A-Cat's 2025 anime adaptation drew complaints about fights built from panning still images, and a fan petition demanding a redo passed 40,000 signatures. It was created by TurtleMe, the pen name of Brandon Lee, who began serializing it online in 2017, with Fuyuki23 illustrating its webtoon. For 10 points, name this series in which the assassinated King Grey is reincarnated as Arthur Leywin.

From his clan's treasure vault, this character claims the Storm Sword Wynnyd, through which he later forms a contract with the Wind Spirit King Tempest. Inside a desert tomb built for him, this character must fight his own former corpse, which Amelia Merwin had raised as a death knight. His signature technique, Ignition, forces extra power out of his heart and mana cores at the cost of his body and lifespan. At his tomb, his old comrades Molon, Anise, Sienna and Vermouth inscribed the titles Brave, Faithful, Wise and Great alongside a string of crude insults. He dies in the castle of the Demon King of Incarceration and is reincarnated 300 years later into a minor branch of his comrade Vermouth's family. For 10 points, name this foul-mouthed mercenary hero, the protagonist of Damn Reincarnation.

This character's sword dance, whose first techniques are Wave, Restraint, Link, Kill and Transcend, was developed by the legendary blacksmith and swordsman Pagma. Because his class cannot use the auto-production button, he forges every item by hand, a process that early on took him at least six hours per item. A bronze statue of the Winston blacksmith Khan bears this character's inscription calling the old man his teacher, friend and family. After using Pagma's Rare Book from an S-rank quest to change class, he becomes a legendary-class player stuck at a negative level. Offline, he is a debt-ridden odd-jobber who plays the virtual reality game Satisfy and eventually leads the Overgeared Guild. For 10 points, give the in-game name of the protagonist of Overgeared.

In this story, the protagonist copies the Sword Emperor skill from the Sword Saint who killed him, splitting the swordsman's ghost Bae Hu-ryeong in two. The protagonist's EX-rank skill Returner's Clockwork Watch sends him 24 hours back in time whenever he dies, preserving his memories and stats. He copied that skill from the Flame Emperor Yoo Soo-ha, who murdered him to cover up the killing of the Saintess. To reach a point eleven years in the past, before the Flame Emperor gained that skill, he kills himself more than four thousand times. Its orphaned hero Kim Gong-ja, named after Confucius, is a jealous F-rank whose S+ skill copies one skill from whoever kills him. For 10 points, name this Sinnoa web novel, due to become a Studio Fu anime in 2027, whose hero must keep dying to grow stronger.
answer: SSS-Class Suicide Hunter [or SSS-Class Revival Hunter; accept Suicide Hunter or Revival Hunter]

question: In this series, the death knight Van Hawk, who had guarded Helain's Grail for the lich Bar Khan, is freed from the lich's control and swears loyalty to the hero. The hero is mocked as head priest of “grass stewism” for feeding hundreds of enslaved gamers nothing but grass stew while they build a giant sphinx. The barbarian Bahamorg, created by the continent's first emperor Geihar von Arpen, serves this story's hero, who eventually becomes King of Arpen. Saenal has cited this web novel as the inspiration for the basic premise of Overgeared. Its impoverished hero Lee Hyun auctions his old game avatar for about three billion won, then joins the virtual reality game Royal Road as Weed. For 10 points, name this Nam Heesung web novel, titled after Weed's secret class.
answer: The Legendary Moonlight Sculptor [or Moonlight Sculptor; accept Dalbich Jogagsa or Dalbit Jogaksa]

question: This series' hero once commanded a lobby called Niflheimr, whose heroes stayed so loyal that they searched every corner of the world for their vanished master. A careless novice master named Wuteva accidentally fuses a four-star hero into the protagonist through synthesis. The in-game developer Moebius claims its heroes run on Quantum AI, but they are really people summoned from other worlds and stripped of their memories. Its protagonist was Loki, the world's fifth-ranked master, who never managed to pull a seven-star hero despite heavy spending. After a level-999 figure tells him “Found you”, Han Seojin wakes as a level-one, one-star hero and must guide a novice master to the 100th floor. For 10 points, name this Hermod web novel and webtoon about a top gacha player trapped inside his game as a lowly hero.

In this story, a patriarch who grew a rice mill into the nation's top business group credits his rise to greed, suspicion and a readiness to change his mind. Its protagonist's business partner is Oh Se-hyeon, alias Mason Oh, and the story's backdrop includes the 1997 Asian financial crisis. Lee Sung-min won the Baeksang Arts Award for Best Actor in television for playing the founder Jin Yang-chul in its adaptation. The 2022 JTBC drama's finale drew 26.9 percent ratings, but its departure from San Kyung's original ending split viewers. Yoon Hyun-woo, a loyal Soonyang Group employee murdered to cover up a tax evasion scheme, wakes in 1987 as the chairman's grandson Jin Do-jun. For 10 points, name this web novel adapted into a hit drama starring Song Joong-ki.
answer: Reborn Rich [or The Youngest Son of a Conglomerate; or The Youngest Son of a Chaebol Family; or Jaebeoljim Mangnaeadeul]

question: In a past life, this swordsman and the dagger-wielding Tang family elder Tang Bo fought side by side so famously that the pair were called the “Twin Sovereigns”. Outsiders began calling him the Blessed Dragon after he single-handedly beat a string of Zhongnan disciples, including Jin Geumryong, at a contest between the two rival sects. His own sect-mates, whom he personally drills into shape, instead nickname him the Mad Dog. In that earlier life, this member of the Three Great Swordsmen died of his wounds right after beheading the Demonic Cult's leader at the peak of the Hundred Thousand Mountain Range. He returns to life a century later as a fifteen-year-old beggar and finds his once-mighty sect sunk in poverty and near ruin. For 10 points, name this protagonist of Biga's web novel Return of the Mount Hua Sect, adapted into a webtoon by Studio LICO.
answer: Chung Myung [or Cheongmyeong; or Cheong Myeong; or Chungmyung; or Qingming; accept Plum Blossom Sword Saint or Master of the Blossoming Blade]

question: Inside the Sealed Demon Cave, this character realized that a rampaging black Imoogi was only an illusion conjured by twenty-four metal fragments. Those fragments reassembled into his founding ancestor's black sword, while a horn of the Imoogi was later forged into his pale White Dragon Blade. At the cult's academy for heirs, the Right Guardian Seob Meng took him as a disciple and taught him the Butterfly Blade Dance. Because his mother, Lady Hwa, was a former servant from outside the Six Clans, a vow forced on her barred him from learning martial arts until he entered that academy. After assassins nearly kill him, a descendant from the future injects him with a seventh-generation device that he at first mistakes for a demon god. For 10 points, name this son of a cult leader's seventh wife, the protagonist of Hanjung Wolya's Nano Machine.
answer: Cheon Yeo-woon [or Yeowoon; or Yeo Woon; or Yeowun; or Yeo-un; or Yeoun; accept Chun Yeowun or Cheon Yeo-un]

question: In this story, the hero spends two years forging the violet-hued sword Snow Flower from a meteorite that a massacred mountain village had once worshipped. Its hero's secret art, the Gathering of Ten Thousand Shadows, is inscribed on his sect's walls in the forgotten language of the Lower Moon Kingdom. His sect was founded to hold back the marauding Silent Night, but the Central Heavenly Alliance and its Nine Skies later conspired to destroy it. The hero then lives for three years as a closely watched captive in his own home, posing as a blacksmith while training in secret. That captivity follows the death of his father Jin Kwan-ho, who, falsely branded a traitor, disbands the sect and takes his own life so that his son will be spared. For 10 points, name this Woo-gak web novel, later adapted into a webtoon, that follows the avenger Jin Mu-won.
answer: The Legend of the Northern Blade [or Bukgeom Jeongi; prompt on Northern Blade]

question: Wolong Sheng's 1959 novel Flying Swallow Startles the Dragon is credited with introducing this setting's “Nine Sects and One Gang”, though its lone gang was not yet the Beggars' Sect. The orthodox camp of this setting also includes the Five Great Families, clans such as the Namgung and the poison-wielding Sichuan Tang. In Korean fiction, those orthodox factions typically oppose unorthodox sapa groups and a demonic cult often based in the Tian Shan mountains. In Return of the Mount Hua Sect, the title sect has lost its seat among this world's Ten Great Sects to Hainan. This term is the Korean reading of a Chinese word meaning “martial forest”, the community of fighters within the wider “rivers and lakes”. For 10 points, give this Korean term for the society of sects, clans and wandering swordsmen, also used as a genre label for Korean fiction set in such Chinese-inspired realms.

Chinese Buddhist texts use this two-character term as a name for Mara, the tempter who tried to turn Siddhartha from enlightenment with a divine army. This figure's first wuxia appearance is traced to Huanzhulouzhu's Legend of the Swordsmen of the Mountains of Shu, where it leads a host of evil immortals. In the 1990s, Han Bi-gwang's master in the manhwa Ruler of the Land, the supreme lord of the unorthodox faction, reshaped this archetype into a domineering conqueror. Nano Machine's protagonist is proclaimed the “Second” one after he claims the black sword of the first one. Chinese and Korean fans gave this title to League of Legends star Faker after he beat all of China's seeded teams on the way to the 2023 Worlds trophy. For 10 points, name this archetypal founder and supreme ruler of the evil cult that opposes the orthodox sects in countless Korean martial-arts stories.
answer: Heavenly Demon [or Cheonma; or Cheon Ma; or Chunma; or Chun Ma; or Tianmo; or Tenma; do not accept or prompt on “Mara”]

question: After suffering this condition twice while training alone, the exorcist Lee Hyun-am of Lee Woo-hyuk's novel Toemarok can channel internal energy only through his right arm. Jin Yong's Ouyang Feng falls into this state after Guo Jing deliberately writes out a corrupted copy of the Jiuyin Zhenjing for him, leaving him insane yet stronger. In Mo Dao Zu Shi, nearly every leader of the saber-wielding Qinghe Nie Clan eventually dies of this condition, as Nie Mingjue does. Chinese psychiatry and the DSM have treated a real-world version of it, linked to overzealous self-cultivation exercises, as a culture-bound syndrome. Its four-character Chinese name joins a word for catching fire with a word for becoming possessed. For 10 points, name this dangerous loss of control over one's internal energy, the reason martial artists must never be disturbed while circulating their energy.
answer: qi deviation [or zouhuo rumo; or zouhuorumo; or juhwaipma; or 走火入魔; or 주화입마; accept qigong deviation; prompt on deviation]

question: In Taoist inner alchemy, the highest of these is nicknamed the “muddy pellet”, while the middle one, at the level of the heart, is called the “crimson palace”. After losing his own in battle, Yoo Kwang-yeon, the third leader of Jin Mu-won's sect, created an imaginary one and filled it with “Shadow Chi”. Nano Machine's protagonist leaves his scheming half-brother Cheon Jongsum crippled for life by shattering his bones and destroying this reservoir of his power. Japanese masters of swordsmanship, calligraphy and the tea ceremony are traditionally said to act from the lowest of these. Martial artists and cultivators store their internal energy in the lower one, located in the lower belly and sometimes called the “sea of qi”. For 10 points, name these energy centers whose Chinese name literally means “elixir field”.
answer: dantian [or dan tian; or tan t'ien; or danjeon; or tanden; accept hara]

question: This character spent eight years waiting to obtain the Bone Chilling Flame, which he later handed to his pupil so that the Flame Mantra could evolve. With his friend Feng Xian, he founded the Falling Star Pavilion, which he led again after his rescue and the forging of a new body. His first disciple, Han Feng, betrayed him with the help of the Hall of Souls, leaving him without a physical body. His soul survived by hiding inside a black ring that eventually passed from a mother to her son. For three years he secretly drained that boy's Dou Qi, so the former prodigy was scorned as trash and dumped by his fiancée, Nalan Yanran. For 10 points, name this alchemist who lives as a soul in Xiao Yan's ring and becomes his master in Battle Through the Heavens.
answer: Yao Lao [or Yao Chen; accept Elder Yao or Venerable Yao or Yao Zun Zhe]

question: A tombstone in Tingen's Raphael Cemetery praises this character as the best elder brother, the best younger brother, and the best colleague. Earlier, he served in Tingen's Nighthawks under captain Dunn Smith, whose squad posed as the Blackthorn Security Company. Guided by Old Neil, he chose the Seer pathway, and he later advanced to Clown after drinking a new potion. His other identities include the detective Sherlock Moriarty, the pirate-hunting adventurer Gehrman Sparrow, and the wealthy tycoon Dwayne Dantès. A young man from modern China wakes up in this history graduate's body after its original owner's apparent suicide. For 10 points, name this protagonist of Cuttlefish That Loves Diving's Lord of the Mysteries.

This group made its public debut when cards were strewn around the corpse of the swindler Lanevus, with the Emperor and the Wheel of Fortune laid on his head. Chinese readers joke that it is a band of turncoats, since most members outwardly follow other gods while secretly answering to its leader. Its rules require every exchange to be fair and equal and forbid exposing the gathering or other members' identities. Its members gather every Monday at three in the afternoon, Backlund time, in Sefirah Castle above the gray fog, where their appearances stay hidden. Its first members besides its leader were Audrey Hall, codenamed Justice, and Alger Wilson, codenamed The Hanged Man, before Derrick Berg joined as The Sun. For 10 points, name this secret society in Lord of the Mysteries, convened by The Fool, whose members take codenames from Major Arcana cards.

This web novel regularly quotes an in-world origin myth whose allegorical parables follow the first human and his ten children. Its setting's recorded history holds only ten rank-nine Venerables, split between the orthodox and demonic paths, among them Red Lotus and Spectral Soul. At the start of the story, its world's five regions, including the Southern Border and the Northern Plains, are separated by regional walls. Its cultivators store primeval essence in an opened aperture, and those who reach rank six or higher are counted as immortals. Its author, whose pen name is identical to the novel's Chinese title, wrote in its preface that he set out to create a true great villain. For 10 points, name this dark cultivation novel that was banned in mainland China in 2019 for promoting “extreme individualism”.
answer: Reverend Insanity [or Gu Zhen Ren; accept 蛊真人; accept Daoist Gu or Gu Daoist Master]

question: In his first life, this character founded the Blood Wing Demon Sect after a Blood Sea Ancestor inheritance turned him into a blood path cultivator. Overusing a killer move in the Northern Plains leaves him an immortal zombie for a long stretch before he regains a living body. Early in his second life, foreknowledge lets him claim the Flower Wine Monk's hidden inheritance on Qing Mao Mountain. At the Gu Yue clan's Aperture Opening Ceremony, his younger twin brother is celebrated for superior aptitude and adopted into a senior clansman's household. After five hundred years, cornered by righteous forces, he uses the Spring Autumn Cicada to send his soul back into his fifteen-year-old body. For 10 points, name this ruthless transmigrator who wields Gu in single-minded pursuit of eternal life.

In Chinese internet slang, this term also mocks anyone, such as a game commentator, whose confident prediction is promptly contradicted by events. In micro-drama jargon, it is paired with the word nixi to label underdog stories of grassroots comebacks. Chinese duanju micro-dramas feature it alongside “power worship” as one of their most common wish-fulfilment plots. Along with leapfrog challenges against higher-ranked foes and “playing the pig to eat the tiger”, it is a stock payoff of shuangwen web fiction. The trope trades on mianzi, a person's social standing, which can be given, lost, or shamelessly disregarded. For 10 points, name this web-fiction payoff in which someone who scorned the protagonist is proven humiliatingly wrong, as if struck across the cheek.
answer: face-slapping [or face slapping; accept face slap; accept dalian or 打脸]

question: In I Shall Seal the Heavens, progress through this realm is measured in Dao Pillars, and a crack-free “Perfect” version had not been seen since ancient times. Its name comes from Daoist inner alchemy, where the teacher Tian Chengyang stressed a preparatory stage of this name before refining essence into qi. In A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, disciples brave the Trial by Blood and Fire to gather herbs for a scarce blue pill named after this realm. That novel says this realm condenses a cultivator's qi from a cloud-like state into a liquid and extends lifespan to about two hundred years. Its two-character Chinese name literally means “constructing the base”. For 10 points, name this cultivation realm that follows Qi Condensation and precedes Core Formation in many immortal-cultivation novels.
answer: Foundation Establishment [or Foundation Building; accept zhuji or 筑基; prompt on Foundation]

question: Though often called a wuxia novel, Huanzhulouzhu's 1932 novel Legend of the Swordsmen of the Mountains of Shu is widely recognized as the first genuine work of this genre. After 1949, mainland China condemned the genre as superstitious “poison grass” and banned it, forcing that novel's author to stop writing. Its cultivation subgenre took the idea of character levels from 1990s role-playing video games while drawing on Daoist neidan. Fan translations of Stellar Transformations and I Shall Seal the Heavens helped popularize it outside Greater China. Hit television dramas in this genre include Eternal Love, Ashes of Love, and Love Between Fairy and Devil. For 10 points, name this Chinese fantasy genre, whose name means “immortal heroes”, that grew out of wuxia and follows Daoist cultivators seeking immortality.
answer: xianxia [or xian xia; accept 仙侠 or 仙俠; do not accept or prompt on “wuxia” or “xuanhuan”]

question: In A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, surviving a failed attempt at this ordeal leaves a cultivator a Loose Immortal with a greatly shortened lifespan. Another novel warns that killing a cultivator mid-ordeal makes one an enemy of the sky, and bystanders struck by its bolts incur karma until death. In the drama The Journey of Flower, the immortal Bai Zihua's only such ordeal is the orphan Hua Qiangu, whom his master orders him to kill. The second character of its Chinese name abbreviates jiebo, a transliteration of the Sanskrit kalpa, and in modern usage suggests calamity. Some novels explain that it arrives because seeking immortality defies the celestial will, often just as a cultivator breaks into a new stage. For 10 points, name this ordeal in which bolts of lightning rain down from the sky on a cultivator nearing immortality.
answer: Heavenly Tribulation [or tianjie; accept 天劫; accept Heaven's Tribulation; accept lightning tribulation or thunder tribulation; prompt on tribulation]

question: This character always wears a storage belt called the Twenty-Four Moonlight Bridges, and he eventually earns the title Thousand Hands Douluo. In a past life, he was an outer-sect disciple of an assassin clan who secretly mastered its forbidden inner-sect arts, then leapt from Hell's Peak. Reborn as the son of the Clear Sky Douluo, he awakens twin martial souls: the Clear Sky Hammer and Blue Silver Grass, which most people dismiss as trash. He loves Xiao Wu, a 100,000-year-old Soft Boned Rabbit in human form, and both belong to the Shrek Seven Devils of Shrek Academy. Xiao Zhan played him in Douluo Continent, a 2021 live-action series that premiered on Tencent Video. For 10 points, name this reincarnated protagonist of the Chinese web novel Soul Land, also called Douluo Dalu.

In The Unrivaled Tang Sect, special tools strip a killer's aura from dying beasts, making these objects “ownerless” so someone other than the killer can absorb them. Claiming one of these from a beast of ten thousand years or more also means withstanding a dangerous “shock” unleashed before the dead beast's essence dissipates. Taking one older than a recommended limit, such as about 423 years for the first, risks heavy injury or even death. In the first two series, the optimal full set of nine is two yellow, two purple and five black. In Douluo Dalu, a master must personally land the killing blow on a beast to claim one of these at each bottleneck, every ten ranks. For 10 points, name these objects, colored white at ten years, yellow at a hundred, purple at a thousand, black at ten thousand, and red at a hundred thousand.
answer: soul rings [or spirit rings; accept soul ring or spirit ring; accept hunhuan or 魂环; prompt on rings]

question: This cultivator's signature weapon is a set of seventy-two Bamboo Cloudswarm Swords, forged from Heaven Lightning Bamboo that he nurtured to ten thousand years of age. As a boy nicknamed “Second Fool”, he became a disciple of the Seven Mysteries Sect's Doctor Mo, who poisoned him and later tried to seize his body. His mediocre talent of four false spiritual roots lacking metal makes him the model hero of the “mortal stream” that his novel pioneered. He secretly relies on a Mysterious Small Bottle whose jade-green liquid rapidly matures any plant, including rare medicinal herbs. Youku and Netflix released The Immortal Ascension, a 2025 live-action series adapting his story. For 10 points, name this village boy who is the protagonist of Wang Yu's A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality.

Pages of this novel's central tome hold the Unyielding Golden Skeleton and, much later, the Demon Eye of Annihilation. Its hero obtains an Ancestral Dragon Source on a cave trip, starting him on the path to becoming a Divine Spirit with a Golden Dragon bloodline. The hero is the ninth young master of the Yang Family, one of the Eight Great Families of the Great Han Dynasty. A black book containing the Great Demon God's legacy cures the genetic defect that had kept him from cultivating. Written by Momo, the Chinese original of this novel ran to 6,009 chapters before it was completed. For 10 points, name this web novel whose hero Yang Kai starts out as a lowly sweeper and Trial Disciple of High Heaven Pavilion.
answer: Martial Peak [accept Wu Lian Dian Feng or 武炼巅峰]

question: With Su Muqiu, this player designed the Myriad Manifestation Umbrella, a twelve-form silver weapon that skips the cooldown on switching weapons. Nicknamed the “Glory Textbook”, he is counted among the Four Master Tacticians and later captains the Chinese national team. He turned pro under his wealthy twin brother's identity and won three straight titles for Excellent Era with the Battle Mage account One Autumn Leaf. Forced to resign, he becomes night-shift manager of Chen Guo's Happy Internet Cafe and starts over on the tenth server with the Unspecialized Lord Grim. Yang Yang played him in a 2019 live-action series, two years after a Tencent animated adaptation began. For 10 points, name this protagonist of Butterfly Blue's esports novel The King's Avatar.
answer: Ye Xiu [or Ye Qiu; accept 叶修 or 叶秋]

question: This novel's hero vows to unravel the mystery of the Battle of Divine Will and argues gifted women should drive civilization rather than be used as consumables. Its first volume, “Song of Months of Demons”, covers a frontier town's defense against demonic hybrid beasts during the Months of Demons. Its heroine Anna is spared from hanging and put to work firing cement and welding metal, and her flames later turn green. Er Mu's novel was adapted into a manhua starting in 2017 and into a Thundray donghua streamed on Crunchyroll in 2026. Its protagonist is Cheng Yan, a mechanical engineer who dies of overwork and wakes in the body of Roland Wimbledon, a prince of Graycastle. For 10 points, name this web novel in which a transmigrated prince industrializes Border Town with help from magic-wielding women he rescues from the Church.
answer: Release That Witch [accept Fangkai Nage Nüwu or Fangkai Nage Nuwu or 放开那个女巫]

question: When his students feel earnest gratitude for his teaching, this man may gain a golden page, which he can use to seal enemies or raise his soul depth. At his birth, the tablet of Kong Shi, the sage who established the Master Teacher Pavilion, rose into the air as if greeting a peer. By merging the correct portions of many manuals, he forms flawless techniques such as the Heaven's Path Divine Art and Heaven's Path Sword Art. His novel's blurb has him chiding an emperor who refuses to wear underwear and a demon lord who eats too much garlic. A librarian from Earth, he wakes in the body of the most pathetic teacher at Hongtian Academy, who had scored zero on the qualification exam. For 10 points, name this protagonist of Heng Sao Tian Ya's Library of Heaven's Path, whose mind holds a library that compiles books on the flaws of anything he sees.

This writer's pen name, drawn from her mother's remark when she wanted to study literature rather than economics, pairs the fragrance of ink with the stench of money. One of this author's narrators is an anti-fan known online as Peerless Cucumber who transmigrates into Shen Qingqiu, a villain of the harem novel Proud Immortal Demon Way. In 2020 this writer was sentenced to three years in prison for “illegal business operation” after selling her self-published books, and she was paroled in 2021. In another of her novels, the scrap-collecting Xie Lian, once Crown Prince of Xianle, ascends to heaven a third time and keeps crossing paths with the ghost king Hua Cheng. Her novel about the Yiling Patriarch Wei Wuxian and Lan Wangji became the 2019 live-action drama The Untamed, starring Xiao Zhan and Wang Yibo. For 10 points, name this danmei author of Grandmaster of Demonic Cultivation and Heaven Official's Blessing, whose novels were first serialized on Jinjiang Literature City.
answer: Mo Xiang Tong Xiu [or MXTX; or Moxiang Tongxiu; or Moxiang; or Mo Xiang; or Yuan Yimei; accept 墨香铜臭]

question: Early chapters of this author's breakthrough novel drew criticism for resembling Wang Yu's A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, a similarity he later acknowledged. Before writing full-time, this Heilongjiang University graduate taught English in Mudanjiang, and he began posting online fiction in 2009. In 2016 he was among the first group of web writers elected to the National Committee of the China Writers Association. Another of his heroes, the death-fearing Bai Xiaochun of the Spirit Stream Sect, leads a comic novel that became a 2D Tencent Video donghua in 2020. This author's hero Wang Lin fails the Heng Yue Sect's entrance test but rises after finding the Heaven Defying Bead, which holds the trapped soul of Situ Nan. For 10 points, name this Chinese web novelist of Renegade Immortal and I Shall Seal the Heavens.

Anonymous auctions of this character's Bedevilment Pill, stamped with a square cauldron icon, earned him the alias Grandmaster Pill Cauldron. Born with a Nirvana Brand, this character underwent Nirvanic Rebirth twice in early childhood before his parents left him behind in Yunjie County. This character's closest companions include the Meat Jelly and a proud parrot called Lord Fifth, who was sealed inside one of his treasures. A seemingly useless Copper Mirror he was tricked into choosing from the Treasure Pavilion lets this character duplicate items in exchange for spirit stones, fueling his obsession with them. This scholar was kidnapped into the Reliance Sect by his future beloved, Xu Qing, after failing the imperial examinations for a third time. For 10 points, name this Ninth Generation Demon Sealer, the protagonist of I Shall Seal the Heavens.

After undergoing the Redding Clan's Ancestral Baptism, this character gained a Water-style Demigod Divine Clone and the innate ability Dragon Roar. Earlier, this character single-handedly cleared the eleventh floor of the Necropolis of the Gods, collecting three Divine Sparks and many Divine Artifacts. At the Ernst Institute, this character befriends Yale, George and Reynolds and meets his future wife, Delia. This character's companion Bebe, an infant Shadowmouse he coaxed into a bond of equals, is later revealed to be a Godeater Rat. His mentor, the Saint-level earth magus Doehring Cowart, survives as a spirit inside a ring and teaches him a single-chisel stone sculpting technique. For 10 points, name this Dragonblood Warrior who is the protagonist of the web novel Coiling Dragon.

One of this author's heroes is Qin Yu, a prince's third son born unable to cultivate internal energy, whose fate changes after the Meteoric Tear merges with his body. Born in 1987 in Baoying, Jiangsu, this author attended Soochow University's mathematics department but left without graduating. His novel Desolate Era, about the reborn Ji Ning, was adapted into the 2018 drama The Legend of Jade Sword, starring Hawick Lau. Another of his heroes, Luo Feng, joins the Fire Hammer Squad to hunt monsters in a world reshaped by the RR virus. For 10 points, name this Chinese web novelist who wrote Coiling Dragon and Swallowed Star.
answer: I Eat Tomatoes [or Wo Chi Xi Hong Shi; or Wochixihongshi; or Zhu Hongzhi; accept 我吃西红柿; prompt on Tomatoes or Tomato]

question: A silver pendant around this character's neck, later identified as the Mirror of Samsara, twice triggers his rebirth without his knowledge. After swallowing a red bead later identified as the Evil God's Fire Seed, this character sees his profound veins turn crimson. Jasmine, a Star God princess detoxifying a deadly poison inside this character's pearl, forces him to kneel as her disciple and grants him the Evil God's profound veins. Cornered at Cloud's End Cliff, this character swallowed the Sky Poison Pearl and leapt to his death, after which the pearl merged with his left hand. He wakes in the body of a crippled youth of Floating Cloud City who was poisoned on the day of his wedding to Xia Qingyue. For 10 points, name this protagonist of Mars Gravity's web novel Against the Gods.

In 2016 this platform entered China under the name Dongman Manhua and Japan as XOY, a service later folded into a sister manga app. Its anti-piracy tool Toon Radar hides invisible watermarks in every chapter, letting the company trace a leaked copy back to the account that downloaded it. In 2021 its parent completed the purchase of the storytelling site Wattpad, and in 2025 Disney agreed to take a two percent stake. Readers spend coins to unlock Fast Pass chapters early, while amateur creators self-publish in its open section called Canvas. Its Los Angeles-based holding company began trading on the Nasdaq under the ticker WBTN in June 2024 at 21 dollars a share. For 10 points, name this platform launched by a Korean web portal in 2004, whose global English app debuted in 2014 with Tower of God.
answer: Webtoon [or Naver Webtoon or Line Webtoon or Webtoon Entertainment or Webtoons.com]

question: This platform’s “novel comics” push turned proven web novels into webtoons, and What’s Wrong with Secretary Kim became its first such adaptation to be spun off into a TV drama. Written off as a flop in mid-2013, it rebounded after signing popular serials led by a mega-hit game-fantasy novel. Actor Park Bo-gum became its first brand ambassador in 2017, the year it aired its first TV commercial. Its operator was founded in 2010 as a subsidiary called Podotree and took this platform’s name in 2018. Solo Leveling was serialized on it as a web novel from 2016 and as a webtoon from 2018. For 10 points, name this Korean mobile content platform, launched in 2013, whose “free if you wait” model, added in 2014, unlocks one episode after a timer.
answer: KakaoPage [or Kakao Page; prompt on Kakao or Kakao Entertainment; do not accept or prompt on “Kakao Webtoon”]

question: Fans nickname this site “Dal-dongne”, or moon village, and its female-oriented romance offshoot is likewise named Honeymoon. It grew from a 2002 community for Korean martial-arts fiction founded by the novelist Geumgang, which absorbed fantasy writers before adopting its current name in 2006. In 2021 Korea’s two internet giants vied to buy it, and CJ ENM joined the winning consortium by agreeing to buy half of a stake held by Tencent’s investment arm. Its new owner’s webtoon arm, holding about 56 percent, co-hosted a one-billion-won web novel contest with it in 2022. Its free-serialization boards and “Today Best” rankings made it the main open launchpad for male-oriented Korean web novels. For 10 points, name this Korean web novel site, called the country’s third-largest in 2021, where Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint debuted in 2018.

This site was notoriously quick to post raw chapters after official release, so overseas fans routinely scraped its uploads to translate and repost abroad. Its chapters were free to read but surrounded by banner ads for unlicensed betting operators, leading to a charge of promoting illegal gambling. SimilarWeb logged about 126 million visits to it in March 2026, and a 2024 industry estimate put its damage to Korean web comics at 39.8 billion won. Its operators abruptly shut it down in April 2026, promising to delete all user data and disowning any future copycat. In June 2026 its alleged operator, who had acquired Japanese citizenship, became the first Japanese national extradited to Korea under a 2002 treaty. For 10 points, name this illegal webtoon site, in effect Korea’s biggest after Bamtoki’s 2018 shutdown, which ran alongside Manatoki and Booktoki.

In 2020 this site launched an “@Home” network that let volunteers lend their own servers and bandwidth to cache and deliver its images. A December 2019 subpoena on behalf of Viz Media, over uploads of Boruto chapters, led it to shut down briefly and return on a temporary .cc domain. In May 2025 a wave of DMCA notices from publishers such as Kodansha and Square Enix stripped hundreds of series from it in an unprecedented takedown. In March 2021 a hacker hijacked its administrator accounts, demanded a bitcoin ransom, and leaked its source code on GitHub, prompting its operators to take the site offline. Its volunteers then rewrote the whole codebase as version 5, opening the new API to the public in May 2021. For 10 points, name this not-for-profit aggregator of fan-translated manga, manhwa, and manhua, started by the developer Hologfx in 2018.

A March 2026 “Revival” update from this group defended its subscriptions, the priciest costing just over a dollar a month, and said it had dropped third-party ads. That update also moved its site back to its original domain from an address ending in “comic.net”, while shifting its images onto a CDN. Leadership of this group passed to a longtime member named Kita, whom an open letter called a crucial part of the team. That letter said the founder was stepping down over “future legal concerns”, while pointing to its millions of readers around the world. Its English releases include Korean action hits such as Nano Machine, Solo Max-Level Newbie, and Return of the Mount Hua Sect. For 10 points, name this manhwa scanlation group whose name is shared with power-seeking demigods of Hindu and Buddhist myth.

Series pages on this site list a work’s “Status in COO”, meaning its country of origin, beside yes-or-no fields for “Licensed” and “Completely Translated”. Each entry also collects “Associated Names” in many scripts and ranks how many users have added it to their Reading Lists. Its menus offer a Series Finder, a Series Ranking, user-made Rec Lists, Release Filtering, and a Random Novel link. Archived in July 2015, its homepage carried the plainer tagline “Directory of Translated Novels” above daily tables of titles, chapter numbers, and translation groups. For 10 points, name this self-described directory of Asian translated novels, where readers track the chapter releases of fan translation groups.

This site's founder took his online handle from an abbreviation of Ren Woxing, his favorite character in Jin Yong's The Smiling, Proud Wanderer. That founder, Jingping Lai, was a United States diplomat who had first posted translations on the SPCNET forum before launching this site in December 2014. Early on it promised to keep its chapters free, relying on ads and reader donations, but by 2021 about 85 percent of its revenue came from monthly subscriptions. In December 2021 it was bought for about 37.5 million dollars by Radish Media, an American subsidiary of a South Korean entertainment giant. Its founder's first translation project, which he completed on this site, was the 807-chapter fantasy epic Coiling Dragon. For 10 points, name this Hong Kong-based English translation site for Chinese and Korean fantasy novels, once described as the largest Chinese-to-English translation platform.

Wu Wenhui and five fellow members of an online fantasy fan community, the Chinese Magic Fantasy Union, launched this site in May 2002. In October 2003 it introduced a paid “VIP” chapter system, charging two fen per thousand characters and sharing the fees with authors, which became the industry's standard model. Shanda acquired it in 2004, and in 2015 it became part of China Literature, formed by merging the online publishing arms of Shanda and Tencent. After Tencent executives replaced its founding team at the head of that parent group in April 2020, authors protested new contract terms with a “no-updating day” on May 5. For 10 points, name this flagship Chinese web-fiction site, whose name means “starting point”, where Battle Through the Heavens and Lord of the Mysteries were serialized.
answer: Qidian [or Qidian Chinese Network; or 起点中文网; do not accept or prompt on “China Literature” or “Yuewen”]

question: In July 2024 this platform's authors protested an “AI training” supplementary agreement covering their outlines and chapters, and it responded by letting signers withdraw from the clause. Sanjiu Yinyu's hit urban fantasy I Learned to Slay Gods in a Mental Hospital was serialized on this platform. Its parent company advertises its stories with deliberately low-budget video trailers on Douyin, the Chinese counterpart of TikTok. Rather than charging per chapter like China Literature, it gives its novels away and earns money from in-book ads, passing 10 million daily users within about a year. For 10 points, name this free reading app launched in 2019 by ByteDance, whose name refers to a red fruit.
answer: Fanqie Novel [or Tomato Novel or Tomato Fiction; or 番茄小说]

question: Police in Jixi County, Anhui, led the officially designated “305” case against this site's contributors, a pursuit that critics likened to profit-seeking “fishing the high seas”. It was set up in 2015 under a Taiwanese publisher, Longma Culture, and keeps its servers in Taiwan, out of reach of mainland censors. It announced a month-long suspension in June 2025, and police in Lanzhou launched a second wave of arrests after it came back online. One of its top-earning authors was sentenced to four and a half years in prison, forfeited her earnings, and was fined an equal amount. For 10 points, name this Taiwan-hosted danmei, or boys' love, fiction website, dozens of whose mainland writers have been charged since 2024 with producing obscene material for profit.
answer: Haitang Literature City [or Haitang Culture Online Literature City; or 海棠文化線上文學城]

question: The original site of this name, a scanlator-friendly reader founded in 2011 by an admin called Grumpy, closed in January 2018, and its domain later passed to the Mangawindow group. Its later incarnation was run from China but blocked visitors from mainland China to avoid drawing the attention of local authorities. In September 2025 the Japanese anti-piracy body CODA filed a criminal complaint in Shanghai on behalf of publishers including Shueisha, Kodansha and Square Enix. On November 19, 2025, police detained a man in Guangxi who admitted running this network of about 60 sites, which earned over 400,000 yuan in ad income in peak months. A South Korean publisher's anti-piracy team shut down its Discord server and subreddit after the network went offline in January 2026. For 10 points, name this free manga and manhwa aggregator, for a time the world's largest manga piracy site, with about 350 million visits in May 2025.

Official English translations of My Young Lady Is a NEET and I'm Just a Side Character in a Dating Simulation appeared on this service. In mid-2022 this service posted sample chapters of 60 series on Anime-Planet and began showing that site's community ratings on its own pages. Launched in April 2021, it claimed over 15 million monthly users and more than 700 titles translated into English, Indonesian and Spanish. The company billed Heaven Official's Blessing, whose story was also adapted into anime, as its most popular series. Citing a change in “strategic direction”, it disabled sign-ups and coin top-ups in late January 2024 and shut down on February 29 of that year. For 10 points, name this international webtoon and manhua app run by the Chinese video site known for scrolling “bullet” comments and named after a nickname of Misaka Mikoto.
answer: Bilibili Comics [or Bilibili Manga; or 哔哩哔哩漫画; prompt on Bilibili]

question: During the fight with the ice elf Baruka, this character cut down the crazed hunter Kim Chul, who was then raised as the shadow Iron. This character habitually brings the severed heads of his kills back to his master, and he is irritated when Iron starts imitating the habit. In the anime episode titled “Arise”, two attempts to extract him fail before a speech urging him to fight for someone rather than guard an empty throne wins him over. As a dungeon boss, this knight tossed his sword aside when his opponent chose to fight bare-handed, then lost his left eye to a dagger. For 10 points, name this loyal knight, the first major shadow soldier that Sung Jinwoo extracts in Solo Leveling.
answer: Igris [or Igrit; or Ygritte; accept Blood-Red Commander Igris or Knight Commander Igris the Bloodred]

question: Angry at ranking below Phantaminum, this man broke into the Ranking Administration Office, only for the captured Robert Aisand to predict he would lose a fight between the two. After fighting Arie Hon to a standstill in a 100th-Floor special test, he took control of the 77th Floor and gave it to his best friend, Baek Ryun. Garam Zahard banned this man from the Floor of Death after his repeated failures to win her heart, and he later returned wearing an anklet that masked his power. On that floor, he used a syringe from the Workshop to tear the Red Thryssa, which he had once given to Hell Joe, out of Joe's body. Inside Zygaena, he let Jyu Viole Grace's team keep a spare flower after Viole managed to scratch his cheek. For 10 points, name this silver-haired Irregular known as the Ray Barracuda, the fourth-ranked High Ranker and vice captain of Wolhaiksong in Tower of God.

After fighting Vampire Duke Cambormere in the Bloody Citadel, this character absorbed a Vampire essence that lets him resist death as long as his heart is intact. This character straps on a helmet with a candle fixed to its front, a look he calls “barbarian candle mode”. He fooled an evil-spirit hunter by feigning ignorance and beating the man up, since exposed transmigrators are sent to the guillotine. He believes that every Hans brings him disaster, a jinx that began when a Hans who offered to share night watch on the first floor proved to be a raider. A 29-year-old Korean office worker who had spent nine years on the brutally hard game Dungeon & Stone wakes up in this character's body. For 10 points, name this 6-foot-5 barbarian tank, the protagonist of Surviving the Game as a Barbarian.
answer: Bjorn Yandel [or Bjorn son of Yandel; accept Hansu Lee or Lee Hansu; prompt on Yandel]

question: The goddess Gula kept putting the word “mana” into this character's class names, such as Mana Spearman and Mana Lancer, until Luxuria stepped in with Lance of Nemesis. In his first life, this Red Mark indentured to Sinyoung fell in humanity's last stand, and the dying Teresa Hussey offered the Royal Oath to get his wish granted. Waking from a dream of that life, he talked Kim Hannah into giving him a Gold Mark. In the Neutral Zone, he cleared the Impossible mission with a Necessary Talisman that unleashed a magnitude-12 earthquake. Overusing his innate Nine Eyes broke his Magic Circuit, and losing those color-coded signals drove him into a ruinous gambling addiction. For 10 points, name this spear-wielding protagonist of The Second Coming of Gluttony.

Using a method from a half-burned magic book, this character builds extra mana cores around his natural one, arranging them in an inverted triangle for explosive bursts of power. In his first life, he ranked seventh among the Continent's Seven Strongest until the Noble Knight Idun wore him down with massed troops and killed him. After regressing, he cured the sick daughter of Gillion, a former mercenary leader who then pledged him eternal service. His childhood tutor Belinda, a poison-making assassin who serves as his maid, dotes on him as if he were her own son. His first life's downfall began when his younger sister Elena was killed after he refused to take her to a festival. For 10 points, name this Mercenary King who wakes up as his teenage self in The Regressed Mercenary Has a Plan.
answer: Ghislain Perdium [or Cecil Perdium; accept Ghislaine Perdium; prompt on Perdium]

question: An aged White Imoogi guarding the Golden Heaven Yeon Family's secret vault in Sichuan gave its core to this character, lifting his Infernal Fire Wheel Technique to three stars. He won a Dragons and Phoenixes Tournament by defeating Jang Seonyeon in the final, earning the epithet “True Dragon”. His fiancée Namgoong Bi-ah smells a foul stench from nearly everyone, but finds him completely odorless and tracks him by that absence of scent. In his first life, he betrayed the orthodox faction to serve an evil cult's leader, then died of a curse meant to prevent betrayal after answering his captor's questions. He wakes at fourteen on the day he first met Wi Seol-ah, whose potato he had once refused, and this time she becomes his servant. For 10 points, name this heir of Shanxi's Gu Clan, the protagonist of Ubilam's web novel Childhood Friend of the Zenith.
answer: Gu Yangcheon [or Yang-cheon; or Yang Cheon; or 구양천; accept Black Flame Demon Sovereign or Black Flame Demon Emperor]

question: The Gwi family spent centuries perfecting this story's forbidden time-reversal art, whose ninety-nine materials include the Echoing Thunder Bell and five million nyang. Before performing that ritual, the Ghost Gate master Gwi Ryeongja asks its hero to find his younger self and stop him from getting married. When working undercover, its hero calls himself Geom Yeon, saying the Yeon means smoke rather than fate because he will vanish like smoke. After winning a succession duel whose victor is granted any wish, its hero asks his father only to go hunting with him. Its hero seeks revenge on Hwa Moogi, the Everlasting Martial God, who killed the leaders of the martial world's three great factions, including his father Geom Woojin. For 10 points, name this Jang Young-hoon web novel and 2024 webtoon in which Geom Mugeuk, second son of a demonic cult's leader, turns back time for revenge.

In this story, the primeval god Visnu named the gods and suras in alternation, but Kali stole the flawed and dangerous names that were left over. Its creator began it in 2008 in an unpaid amateur tier, then relaunched a rebooted version as an official series in 2010. Its suras are generally stronger than its gods but have only one life, whereas its gods resurrect whenever they are killed. The magician Asha Rahiro, who has never shown anyone her right arm, is the only magician on the planet Willarv to hold an A++ rank. Its heroine, who uses the alias Leez Haias formed from her parents' surnames, loses her village to a red, bird-like sura on her sixteenth birthday. For 10 points, name this Currygom fantasy webtoon, titled after the secret birth name that its heroine shares with a god renowned for his wealth.

In a side story from this series, a future Royal is tricked into believing a worthy Jack must hit distant targets with thrown cafeteria forks, which become his trademark weapon. Arlo won the Ringo Award for Fan Favorite Villain in 2017 and 2018, and this series' protagonist took the same prize in 2020. Each school in this series has Royals with playing-card titles, and Wellston's Ace is the time-manipulating god-tier Seraphina. Its protagonist's aura manipulation lets him copy other people's abilities, a power he once used to become King of New Bostin High School. At Wellston, he wears his hair gelled flat and pretends to be powerless, until he reveals his strength as the masked Joker. For 10 points, name this uru-chan superhero webtoon starring John Doe.

This story's creator said one villain's name can mean either a spoiled son of a family that prizes boys or a man scarier than a ghost. In 2011, it was the only webtoon on its Korean portal restricted to readers aged 19 or older, so its creator posted mosaic-censored chapters on his blog. In its TV adaptation, science teacher Lee Byeong-chan creates the Jonas Virus, hoping to make his bullied son Jin-su strong enough to fight back. In that version, class president Choi Nam-ra becomes an immune half-zombie, gaining superhuman strength and senses while craving human flesh. Yoon Chan-young stars as Lee Cheong-san, the childhood friend and neighbor of Nam On-jo, in its live-action version, which premiered in January 2022. For 10 points, name this Joo Dong-geun zombie webtoon, adapted into a Netflix series in which students fight to survive an outbreak at Hyosan High.
answer: All of Us Are Dead [or Now at Our School; or Jigeum Uri Hakgyoneun; or 지금 우리 학교는; accept School Attack]

question: In this creator's webtoon Timing, a teacher who dreams of coming disasters joins a boy who can stop time to prevent a string of deaths at a high school. About 15,000 online donors helped rescue the stalled 2012 film of his 26 Years, in which children of Gwangju massacre victims plot to assassinate the ex-president they hold responsible. He scripted Disney+'s 2024 adaptation of his Light Shop, about a store at the end of a dark alley where souls linger between life and death. His pen name comes from the Korean word for grass, a nickname he earned by frequently wearing green as a Korean literature student at Sangji University. In one of his stories, the flying Kim Bong-seok and the regenerating Jang Hui-soo are high schoolers whose parents secretly served as government black-ops agents. For 10 points, name this Korean webtoon creator who wrote the 2023 Disney+ superhero series Moving, adapted from his own webtoon.
answer: Kang Full [or Kang Pool; or Kangfull; or Kang Do-young; accept Kang Do-yeong or Gang Do-young or 강풀]

question: One of this author's heroes awakens in the Gods' and Demons' Cemetery ten thousand years after his death and sets out to find his lost love, Yu Xin. His later works include Beyond the Deep Space, his first try at future science fiction, and Night Without Bounds, set in a world where the sun never rises. Another of his heroes grows up in Stone Village, guarded by the Willow God, a lightning-scorched tree that ousted the village's old guardian spirit. That boy, Shi Hao, nearly died as a small child when his clan dug out his rune-covered Supreme Bone and transplanted it into his cousin Shi Yi. In another of his novels, Ye Fan and his old classmates are swept from a reunion on Mount Tai into a bronze coffin hauled by nine dragon corpses. For 10 points, name this Chinese web novelist who wrote the loosely linked trilogy of Shrouding the Heavens, Perfect World and The Sacred Ruins.
answer: Chen Dong [or Chendong; or Yang Zhendong; accept 辰东 or 辰東]

question: One of this author's heroes, Long Haochen, is the son of a Divine Knight and captains Demon Hunt Squad 1 in Throne of Seal. Luo Jin played a fictionalized version of this author in My Story for You, a 2018 iQIYI drama based on his autobiographical novel about courting his wife. In 2012 Guinness World Records recognized him for releasing new installments every day for 86 consecutive months. On the show Day Day Up, he explained that his pen name sounds like a phrase for adding three spoonfuls of sugar to soy milk.
