Another of his heroes, Huo Yuhao, awakens the rare Spirit Eyes and carries a million-year-old Skydream Ice Worm in his spiritual sea. For 10 points, name this Beijing-born web novelist whose Soul Land, also called Douluo Dalu, grew into a franchise of donghua, comics and games.
answer: Tang Jia San Shao [or Tangjia Sanshao; or Tangjiasanshao; or TJSS; or Zhang Wei; accept 唐家三少]

question: In this story, the spymaster Xiao En and the grandmaster Ku He lose their cavalry escort but outlast a polar night to reach the mysterious Temple in the far north. Its hero survives an arrow from the ninth-rank archer Yan Xiaoyi only because the shot strikes the key to a box his mother left behind. Its 2019 adaptation drew backlash when Tencent Video and iQIYI charged subscribers extra to watch episodes early, a scheme that later cost iQIYI a lawsuit. When the Northern Qi scholar Zhuang Mohan claims its hero stole lines of “Climbing High”, the hero drunkenly recites hundreds of classical poems at a palace banquet. Its hero has been guarded since birth by Wu Zhu, a blindfolded grandmaster who served his mother, founder of the Inspection and Control Bureau. For 10 points, name this Mao Ni novel whose 2019 and 2024 drama seasons star Zhang Ruoyun as Fan Xian, a youth born with memories of the 21st century.
answer: Joy of Life [or Qing Yu Nian; or Qingyunian; accept 庆余年 or 慶餘年]

question: After climbing the Black Mountain and spilling his blood on a long-forgotten god's altar, this story's hero is granted the true name Lost from Light. In 2025 Aethon Books announced hardcover print editions of this serial and a webcomic from the team behind the Dungeon Crawler Carl webcomic. His Flaw, Clear Conscience, forbids him from lying and forces him to answer questions truthfully, though he can shade his wording. On the Forgotten Shore he teams up with Cassie, a blind seer, and Nephis, the Changing Star and last daughter of the Immortal Flame clan, before reaching the Dark City. Its hero's mother named him Sunless because he was born during a solar eclipse. For 10 points, name this Guiltythree web novel on Webnovel, in which Sunny is infected by the Nightmare Spell and sent into the Dream Realm.

In the drama Guardians of the Dafeng, the Daoists Li Miaozhen and Chu Yuanzhen are both described as fourth-rank cultivators at this stage. Most cultivators in I Shall Seal the Heavens form only one of these, but its hero drew on Western Desert totems and other powers to form nine. Bai Xiaochun of A Will Eternal forms an exceptional Heaven-Dao version of it by absorbing the spirits of five dead Devas, one for each element. A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality says a cultivator can seize a new body as long as this survives, and can refine pills with its infant fire. Its two-character Chinese name has been glossed as a Daoist “Dao embryo”, and the step after it lets the primordial spirit leave the body. For 10 points, name this cultivation realm, formed from a cultivator's golden core, in which the spirit takes the shape of a tiny infant.
answer: Nascent Soul [or Yuanying or Yuan Ying; accept 元婴 or 元嬰; prompt on Nascent]

question: Bae Do-bin, the reincarnated Beethoven of a Korean web novel, subverts a genre cliché by cursing this away the instant it first appears to him. The Korean otherworld novel Memorize modelled its version of this on Dungeons & Dragons and Fate character sheets, a borrowing later criticized as plagiarism. It first appeared in Korean game-fantasy novels, a genre whose first entry, Children of Ogstakalnis, turns a brilliant programmer into a dim-witted warrior through his in-game attributes. In Solo Leveling, Sung Jinwoo's version, which no one else can see, tracks Strength, Agility, Stamina, Intelligence, and Sense, and grants three points after each daily quest. In a running gag, a hero shouts its name after landing somewhere new and nothing happens, and some authors even advertise their novels as lacking it. For 10 points, name this translucent pop-up in web fiction that shows a character's level, skills, and attributes like an RPG character sheet.
answer: status window [or status screen; accept stat window or stats window; accept sangtaechang or 상태창; prompt on status or stats; prompt on system or system window]

question: In 2017 this platform's terms of service briefly gave it a “right of first refusal” over creators' outside rights deals, a clause it dropped a month later after backlash. Its readers unlock premium episodes with an in-app currency called Ink, which can be bought, earned by watching video ads, or tipped directly to creators. Its catalog includes Leeanne Krecic's Let's Play alongside licensed Korean series such as Villains Are Destined to Die and Tomb Raider King. In May 2021, Kakao Entertainment agreed to buy it for about 510 million dollars, together with the mobile fiction app Radish. In September 2026, less than a year after Radish closed, Kakao Entertainment was reported to be shutting this platform down as well. For 10 points, name this North American webcomic and prose platform, launched in 2012 as Comic Panda, whose name evokes bite-sized Spanish snacks.

Kakao's anti-piracy unit P.CoK, named for the eyes on a peacock's feathers, began investigating this group in 2022 and identified three operators living in the United States, India, and Croatia. One of its operators later told Kakao Entertainment that it never became a content aggregator despite several lucrative offers, and that official releases had made sites like it unnecessary. It averaged about 10 million visits a month, and its Discord server had roughly 95,000 members. This group's English fan translations included Leveling with the Gods, Second Life Ranker, and The Archmage Returns After 4000 Years. On May 9, 2025, after about six years online, it announced its permanent closure after receiving a cease-and-desist letter from Kakao Entertainment. For 10 points, name this scanlation group for manhwa and web novels, whose name refers to the scythe-wielding personification of death.
answer: Reaper Scans [or ReaperScans; accept reaperscans.com; do not accept or prompt on “reader”]

question: In February 2024, a .tv domain bearing this site's name went offline with 200-plus sites that used Sarek Oy, a Finnish registrar founded by Pirate Bay co-founder Peter Sunde. Citing One Piece, Shueisha's February 2025 request for a DMCA subpoena against Cloudflare named this site's .com domain. That request sought the operators' addresses, emails, and IP logs, after an earlier Cloudflare subpoena had tied sites named alongside it to Vietnamese telecom companies. One domain in that filing had drawn about 180 million visits in March 2022, more than The Pirate Bay and Fmovies combined. For 10 points, name this unlicensed online manga reader, one of the world's biggest piracy sites, named in that request alongside the cryptic domain mkklcdnv6temp.com.

In this work's setting, the world's last human stronghold is split into fourteen districts, and an underground city lies beneath its sewers, founded by a failed rebel corps. Wizards of that stronghold built a maze that opens at midnight on the first of every month, and those who descend into it for magic stones are called explorers. Its hero's companions include the blonde swordswoman Ainar Fenelin and the fairy Erwen Fornacci di Tersia. Its protagonist is really Hansu Lee, a 29-year-old Korean office worker who spent nine years mastering an infamously difficult dungeon-crawling game before a notice told him his tutorial was over. He now inhabits Bjorn Yandel, a member of a race despised for being useful only in a fight, and must hide that fact while paying crushing taxes to avoid demotion to lower-class citizen. For 10 points, name this webtoon about staying alive inside a role-playing world in a hulking tribal body, a Jung Yoon-kang series.
answer: Surviving the Game as a Barbarian [or Surviving as a Barbarian in the Game; accept STGAAB]

question: One villain of this work is a shaman nicknamed the Third Eye, who has survived for centuries by stealing the bodies of martial masters and shamans. The Heaven-Earth Society, led by Bi Jungseon, descends from remnants of the Dual Martial Forces and is one of three great powers in this work's martial world. Its hero eventually founds the Heavenly Demon Divine Cult to grant the wishes of a reincarnated spirit and takes the name Cheon Ma. A serial killer nicknamed the Slaughtering Scythe Demon is offered a way out of prison because he happens to look exactly like another man. That killer takes over the life of Mok Gyeongwoon, the third young master of the Mok Sword Manor. For 10 points, name this Hanjung Wolya work in which a jailed murderer impersonates a swordsman family's third son, a murim series.
answer: Myst, Might, Mayhem [or Myst Might Mayhem; accept Goeryeok Nansin]

question: Its author BK_Moon set this work in the same fictional universe as I Became the Dragon King's Chef, whose heroine Cheong Sim appears in it. Its hero's family is served by the loyal knight Javier Asrahan, and his parents Arcos and Marbella were driven to suicide by scams and debt in the original timeline. The first creature this work's protagonist summons is a hamster that swells to enormous size after eating red sunflower seeds. Its hero is really Suho Kim, a civil engineering student who fell asleep reading a fantasy novel. He wakes up as a lazy, hard-drinking aristocrat whose house is buried in debt, and applies modern construction know-how to dig it out. For 10 points, name this webtoon about a Korean student turned nobleman who rebuilds a bankrupt fief, a Naver-serialized series.
answer: The Greatest Estate Developer [or The Greatest Estate Designer]

question: The three-way balance of this work's martial world is upset by a clan of blade-users based on Huangshan in Anhui. Its cult's Sword Demon, who lost his right arm to that clan's founder, established a school that opens only once a decade for a four-year course of six one-shot exams. Its hero's father Cheon Yujong, the Southern Demon Lord, was the twenty-third leader of that cult, while his mother was a servant rather than one of the six official wives. A descendant visiting from the future injects the hero with a microscopic device that remakes his body. Yeo-un then competes against powerful half-siblings at the cult's academy for a chance at the rank of Minor Priest. For 10 points, name this Hanjung Wolya work in which future technology meets martial arts, a Heavenly Demon Cult series.

This work's central sword clan was founded by Temar, who contracted the shadow god Solderet and practiced a magic-blade art that later generations forgot. Their rivals, a house of magicians who control nearly half the world's dragons, manipulated history to erase that legacy. A black dragon once bound to Temar becomes the hero's contracted partner in this work. Luna, the eldest child and first flagbearer, wants nothing to do with the succession fight her brother Joshua pursues. Jin, the last of patriarch Chiron's thirteen children and his clan's greatest failure, is thrown out, dies, and is offered a second chance by a deity. For 10 points, name this webtoon about a peerless sword clan and its disgraced last-born, an Emperor Penguin series.
answer: Swordmaster's Youngest Son [or The Swordmaster's Son; accept The Sword Master's Son]

question: The central medical hall in this work is administered by Yooho, a Sky Fox whose fangs make the hero suspect he is not human. Its hero's teacher is Jaegal Lin, the White-Scaled physician and one of the three heavenly healers of jianghu. Its protagonist saves and becomes a sworn brother of Yeo Halyun, the future Demon King and hero of the in-world novel The Supreme Heavenly Demon. Jin Cheonhee, shot by a rebel soldier while shielding a patient on a volunteer mission, wakes as a child beside a wrecked carriage. He converts future villains such as the Phantom Archer Wang Chaebaek into allies by saving the people they love. For 10 points, name this webtoon in which a modern surgeon practices medicine among martial artists, a murim transmigration series.
answer: Doctor's Rebirth [or Doctor, Live Again; accept The Doctor Lives Again]

question: The Zhongnan school of Xian, a long-standing rival in Shaanxi, supplanted this work's Taoist order after it collapsed. Second-grade disciples of that order include Baek Cheon, born Jin Dongryong, and the woman nicknamed the Ice Sword. The third-grade disciples Jo Gul and Yun Jong are among the first to befriend this work's protagonist. A century before the main story, that protagonist beheaded the Heavenly Demon Cheonma and then died of his own wounds. Cheongmyeong wakes in a child's body to find his plum-flower school reduced to a handful of penniless disciples, and sets out to restore it. For 10 points, name this Biga webtoon about a dead sword saint rebuilding his fallen Shaanxi school, a Naver regression series.
answer: Return of the Mount Hua Sect [or Return of the Blossoming Blade; accept Return of the Huashan Sect]

question: House Vayezid rules the northern region in this work, and its second son Josef becomes the hero's employer and master. The slums of Soara, a trading town called the lighthouse of the north, are carved up by five bosses including One-Armed Jack and Captain Hoover. After being hit by black lightning, this work's hero starts hearing a voice, and he can draw wisdom from a sentient weapon. Its protagonist Vlad is a slum orphan who always admired knights, and his back-alley life is upended when a knight of blue moonlight appears. He signs on with that house as a contract knight and carries the nickname Candle Maker. For 10 points, name this Q10-written webtoon about a gutter orphan guided by his talking blade, a Naver knighthood series.

A notoriously violent free company with a miserable success rate, led by Kaor, is hired by this work's protagonist. His personal tutor Belinda, an assassin who never abandoned him, ends up as the Shadow King of the Kingdom of Luthania. His former fiancee Amelia Rayfold eventually becomes queen of the new Kingdom of Norvagen. Its hero, one of the continent's seven strongest, learns as he dies that Duke Delphine did not ruin his house alone. Slain by Idun after starting a great war for vengeance, Ghislain Perdium, called Cecil in the official translation, wakes as his teenage self. For 10 points, name this webtoon about a sellsword king given a second run at saving his family, a Gold Haeng series.
answer: The Regressed Mercenary's Machinations [or The Regressed Mercenary Has a Plan; accept Every Returned Mercenary Has a Plan]

question: One sentient cursed blade in this work can circulate blood like a second heart and save a mortally wounded cult candidate. The Ghastly Monster Hae Ak-Cheon, a Supreme of an infamous heterodox sect, takes this work's hero as his first disciple alongside the twins Song Woo-Hyun and Song Jwa-Baek. Baek Hye-Hyang, the Witch of Black Blood, and her half-sister Baek Ryeon-Ha are rival succession candidates in that sect. Because his dantian was destroyed, this work's protagonist was written off by his family and used as a third-rate spy. Killed while hunting a legendary immortal's secret records, Woon-Hwi wakes on the day he was kidnapped ten years earlier, now able to hear weapons speak. For 10 points, name this Hanjung Wolya webtoon whose hero listens to the voices of blades, a martial-cult series.

A maximum-security prison called Nouvelle Vague sits ten thousand meters below the sea in this work. An imperial academy trains the heirs of the Rok Empire's Seven Great Clans, and its student council is led by the saintess Dolores L. Quovadis. The red-eyed mage Camus Morgue, called the Corpse Queen, promises this work's protagonist that her neck will become his sheath. Its hero Vikir, the despised illegitimate son of the patriarch Hugo, was executed by guillotine on slanderous charges after a lifetime of obedient killing. Given a second life, he hardens his body by immersion in the River Styx and sets out to tear his father's throat out. For 10 points, name this REDICE Studio webtoon about an assassin clan's attack dog biting the master who fed him, a Kakao vengeance series.
answer: Revenge of the Iron-Blooded Sword Hound [or Revenge of the Baskerville Bloodhound]

question: The Alpheas School of Magic in this work sprawls over thirty-three buildings and forty-four training grounds, and its graduates automatically count as unofficial tenth-class spellcasters. The hero's friend Rian Ogent awakens a powerful physical enhancement and later reaches Divine Transcendence, joining the beings known as Yakshas. This work's protagonist was abandoned as a newborn in a stable and raised by the hunter Vincent Arian and his wife Olina. A chance meeting teaches him to enter the field where mages perceive magic, the first step toward casting. Although commoners are told the art belongs to nobles alone, Shirone's gift of Insight and his obsession with books push him on. For 10 points, name this REDICE Studio webtoon about a peasant boy of boundless magical potential, a Kimchi Woo series.

Beneath the surface in this work lies a cavern complex of at least twelve floors whose depths past the tenth are called the Abyss. Every creature born there circulates mana, and condensed stones called Down Gems serve as its currency. This work's hero takes over a long-abandoned serpent-themed labyrinth on the ninth floor, whose summons include a hero-rank maid named Dominique. Its protagonist Kim Jinwoo was born on the twelfth floor to captives of the underground war, then reached the surface and was adopted. Children born underground to kidnapped humans and raised on monster flesh returned to the surface with extraordinary strength and powerful bodies. For 10 points, name this Glumph webtoon that follows Jinwoo from lowly excavator to king of a labyrinth, a Kakao underground series.

A vampire matriarch named Alice von Ataraxia, the boss of the first floor's Hidden Ruins, eventually marries this work's protagonist. His allies include Teresa du Laurentia, the Saintess of Amsterdam, and the swordsman Chun Yoosung. A faction of twelve divisions called the Demonic Humans blocks climbers here while gathering twelve cursed divine artifacts. Kang Jinhyuk had been a streaming content creator for eleven years and was the only person ever to finish a hundred-floor game tower. When that tower appeared in reality and humanity was told to clear each floor within ninety days, his encyclopedic knowledge let him seize everything first. For 10 points, name this Maslow webtoon about a washed-up game streamer who already knows every secret of a real tower, a Naver climbing series.
answer: Solo Max-Level Newbie [or I'm the Max-Level Newbie; accept Max Level Newbie]

question: The Legendary Farmer Piaro, once captain of the Saharan Empire's Red Knights, serves this work's hero as a duke and general. That empire holds more than half the continent inside a virtual world with over 120,000 possible classes. Kraugel, long the top-ranked player, becomes a Sword Saint, while Jishuka's Tzedakah Guild folds itself into the hero's new guild. This work's protagonist obtains a legendary blacksmith class from a book he had planned to sell for cash. Shin Youngwoo, an indebted loser nicknamed Greed, thus becomes a blacksmith who forges unique weapons and wears the best equipment he can make. For 10 points, name this webtoon from Park Saenal's novel about a player who wins by out-equipping everyone, a REDICE Studio series.

The succubus queen Lilith and the destruction-loving demon Balrog, once a servant of Beelzebub, become this work's protagonist's followers. Having beaten the seven archdukes and united the underworld, he was adopted and blessed by the goddess Gaia. On Earth a shadowy organization worshipping demons, led by Satan, tries to remake the planet in the underworld's image, opposed by a band called the Guardians. Oh Kang Woo devoured hundreds of thousands of demons with an authority of predation, and gave up his throne mostly because there was nothing good to eat. He comes home from a hundred centuries below to find an Earth riddled with dimensional gates and full of monster hunters. For 10 points, name this webtoon about a demon king trading his infernal crown for modern Korea, a Butterfly Valley series.
answer: Player Who Returned 10,000 Years Later [or After Ten Millennia in Hell]

question: A talking black cat named Ruru, a Mystic who can take a draconic form, spent years hunting for an apprentice before finding this work's hero. That cat calls Ignet Crescentia, a captain of the Black Knight Order from the Holy Kingdom of Arvilius, a witch. The protagonist's half-sister Kiril was granted the title of enchantress by the royal family at age eleven and can summon a griffin. Airen Parreira took to sleeping as an escape from reality after witnessing his mother's death, and was mocked for it. He then dreams of a talentless man who swung a blade for decades, and wakes able to inherit that endless practice. For 10 points, name this webtoon about a jeered, idle young aristocrat remade by borrowed dreams, a Naver growth series.
answer: Reformation of the Deadbeat Noble [or The Lazy Lord Masters the Sword]

question: An imperial stronghold in this work, based at Xiangyang in Huguang, ranks its members by white, blue, black, and purple robes. Its hero wears the blue robe at sixteen, the black at seventeen, and the purple at eighteen before taking that fortress over at nineteen. His many later titles include Flower Shadow King, Northern King, and Imperial Grand Preceptor. Born into the unremarkable Jeong clan and looked down on by his own relatives, he devised his own martial arts anyway. The catch is that he was fated never to see his twentieth birthday. For 10 points, name this Cheongsiso webtoon about a martial talent racing his own early death, a Studio JHS murim series.
answer: Surviving as a Genius on Borrowed Time [or Chronicles of a Doomed Prodigy]

question: On rare occasions this work's central ability triggers a system error over a duplicated Unique Perk, handing its user an unimagined new gift. A dying friend named Ian orders the protagonist to absorb his heart. That protagonist, Adrian, wakes fifteen years earlier as a good-for-nothing scoundrel, keeping his brutal combat experience and a Player System inherited from Ian. In the ruined future he escaped, an Emperor had wrecked the continent and crushed the last allied forces. Told to save the world, he answers that he could not care less, but promises to chew his enemies' hearts to pieces. For 10 points, name this 2026 webtoon whose title ability swallows other people's talents whole, a Kakao regression series.
answer: Limitless Predation [or The Lord Who Levels Up by Devouring]

question: The school in this work was named for Silvenia, reckoned the greatest mage in history, and covers an entire island southwest of the kingdom. A high-ranking wind spirit named Merilda guards a forest there and can take the shape of a wolf or of that founder. Clarice, the saint of the Church of Telos, enrolls under the false identity of Kylie Echner. Its hero wakes as Ed Rothstaylor, a third-rate villain from the in-world game The Failed Swordsman of Sylvania, disowned by Duke Krepin and thrown out of the dormitory. Living in the woods and chasing a scholarship, he tries to keep clear of the plot, but four heroines will not leave him alone. For 10 points, name this Corita webtoon about a bit-part antagonist trying to stay alive at a magic school, a Green Kyrin series.
answer: The Extra's Academy Survival Guide [or How to Survive at the Academy; accept Surviving the Academy]

question: The Gu clan of Shanxi in this work is headed by the Tiger Hero Gu Cheol-Woon, and though it falls short of the Four Great Families, many expect it to join them. His daughter Gu Hee-Bi, called the Sword Phoenix, had earlier earned the nickname Crimson Flame Crazy Sword for her temper. This work's protagonist once served a purple-haired Heavenly Demon as the Black Flame Demonic Sovereign after turning on the orthodox sects. Wi Seol-ah cut that Heavenly Demon down, and the protagonist died a captive after passing Wi Seol-ah information about the cult. Gu Yang-Cheon then wakes at the very moment he first met his childhood friend and decides to live quietly, only for old enemies to close in one by one. For 10 points, name this webtoon about a reformed demonic martial artist and the girl he grew up beside, a Dubu murim series.
answer: Childhood Friend of the Zenith [or Shadow of the Supreme]

question: Unlike the Righteous Heavenly Alliance and the Iron Blood Steel Fortress, which are federations of hundreds of sects, the third great power of this work's Central Plains is one unified organization. Lee Cheon-Sang, that cult's leader and reckoned the strongest person under heaven, raises several disciples as candidates to succeed him. Its hero cripples the scheming Hong Eui-Moon, gains the maid Anghwa and the bodyguard Ma Dong-Pil, and is betrothed to Yeo Sang-Rin. Chun Hajin, the strongest assassin of that orthodox alliance, is cut down while trying to escape and win his freedom. He wakes inside the body of Seo Ryang, the third young master of the very cult he had fought. For 10 points, name this codezero webtoon about an orthodox killer reborn as a cult heir, a YJ Comics murim series.

To its hero's dismay, this work's system announces that he has awakened the Grandmaster of Magic trait, then Myriad Talents, then the Black Flame Dragon's Charisma. Its protagonist possesses Van Ecclesia, an infamously incompetent troublemaker who happens to be handsome, high-ranking and rich. Born dirt-poor, that protagonist clawed his way up to be called the King of Groveling and a legendary salesman. He was pulled into a client company's fantasy world while playing it for work, having planned only to retire early and coast. Kongbami draws this webtoon from a story by Yoo In, who also wrote Dr. Player. For 10 points, name this 2026 webtoon about a lazy transmigrator who keeps accidentally becoming brilliant, a Kakao comedy series.
answer: The Genius Professor Wants to Take It Easy [or The Genius Professor Wants an Easy Life]

question: Its hero founds the Low-Down Sect in Ilyang prefecture to shield the weak from powerful martial artists, with Cha Seongtae as his general secretary. He absorbs the Black Rabbit Clan and collects former disciples of Dae Nachal such as Hongshin the Red Monkey and Geumhae the Golden Pig. Its author Yu Jin-Seong set it in the same world as A Dance of Swords in the Night and Like a Chilling Flame. Lee Jaha stole the Jade of Heaven from the head of the cult and fell off a cliff while fleeing. He opens his eyes back in his days as a teahouse waiter, being beaten for something he did not do. For 10 points, name this webtoon about a martial arts fanatic given a second run at godhood, a Studio JHS regression series.
answer: The Return of the Crazy Demon [or Return of the Mad Demon]

question: The Madmen Unit in this work includes the axe-wielding Rem of the Wing Tribe, the assassin Sachsen Benzino, and a mage cursed into the shape of a black panther. A frog named Luagarne, nicknamed the Able Decider, can see potential in people that nobody else can. Much of this work takes place at a fortress city on the northern border of the landlocked Naurilia Kingdom, which is ruled by a queen. Its hero is an ordinary swordsman whose lifelong ambition is the elite rank his companions already hold. After being stabbed in the neck, Encrid opens his eyes at the morning of the same day, and can repeat it as often as he needs. For 10 points, name this webtoon about a talentless soldier who dies and repeats a single day again and again, a Soulpung adaptation series.
answer: Eternally Regressing Knight [or The Knight Only Lives Today]

question: This work's hero holds a skill labeled Fabrication, which stores and reproduces the image of an object, though what it makes is merely an illusion. A main quest titled Change of Fate charges him with saving humanity from a doom whose date he already knows. Its protagonist becomes Frondier, a bit player without a drop of divine power. Before that he had failed even the final attempt to conquer Etius, which no one has ever beaten. Lee Ah-Young writes this CarroToon title, which the artist 333 began drawing in 2026. For 10 points, name this webtoon about a student who copies gear as illusions at a magic school, a Kakao transmigration series.
answer: The Academy's Weapon Replicator [or The Academy's Weapon Copycat]

question: An artificial island in the East Sea houses the greatest training institute in this work's world. The Chameleon Troupe, a criminal outfit operating under the cover of the Jeronimo Mercenary Group, saved the infant whose body its hero now wears after a massacre at a Korean evacuation shelter. Kim Suho, the hero of the in-world story The Returnee Hero, ranks first among the cadets, while Chae Nayun is that story's heroine. Billions of people live in this work's world, but only heroines and important supporting characters were ever given names. Kim Hajin, who wrote that story, finds himself inside it as Kim Chundong, a faceless sword-carrying background character. For 10 points, name this Jee Gab Song webtoon in which an author is trapped as a character he never bothered to describe, a Kakao academy series.

This work's five apocalyptic villains include Deus Makalian, Sin of Sloth and captain of the Solar Eclipse Knights, and Yutia Bludia, the Bloody Queen and Sin of Wrath. Those five belong to an organization called Blue Moon, of which this work's protagonist is the so-called God. Allan Pallatio's older brothers Leo and Tonio, known as the Prostitution King and the Drug King, are both fated to die at that organization's hands. A corporate drudge wakes as a minor aristocrat inside a game whose story ends in apocalypse after ten years. He therefore tracks down the children destined to wreck the world and sponsors them, only for the kingdom to decide he is the mastermind behind every crime. For 10 points, name this webtoon about a nobleman who brings up future monsters to be upstanding people, a Studio Lico series.
answer: Raising Villains the Right Way [or The Patron of Villains]

question: The in-world web serial at the heart of this work, written by tls123, ran to 3,149 chapters before ending. That serial's hero, Yoo Joonghyuk, carries a stigma of regression, and a goblin named Bihyung turns up early to run the scenarios. This work opens on a subway train whose passengers are ordered to kill one another before a time limit expires. Constellations here sponsor individual incarnations and pay out coins when they enjoy the show. Its protagonist is an ordinary office worker who alone finished that thirteen-year serial, and therefore alone knows what happens next. For 10 points, name this singNsong webtoon about surviving an apocalypse by knowing the plot, a Munpia apocalypse series.

Twelve zodiac gods in this work awakened twelve saints, among them the Sagittarius mercenary Hugo Otters and the Aquarius pharmacist Sophie Mardi. The Monarchs, leaders of an unknown civilization, treat gods as prey and devour them. Its protagonist was never chosen by any zodiac, yet he was the greatest of them all before his allies betrayed him and left him for dead. Steven Marker of Leo, called the strongest man in the world, is among those he intends to correct. Twenty years on, Lee Geon resurfaces far stronger than before, to the horror of the saints who killed him. For 10 points, name this REDICE Studio webtoon in which Earth's abandoned champion comes back for payback, a Kakao saint series.
answer: Return of the Disaster-Class Hero [or The Return of the Disaster-Class Hero; accept A Disaster Class Hero Has Returned]

question: Grand Marshal Adeshan spends her last time slip on this work's hero as she lies dying. He is then enrolled in Class 787 at the prestigious Philleon school, where he places first in the practical exam and 5,712th in the written one. Its protagonist had been the last man standing of the imperial army after a battle against giants, only to watch an overwhelming host of giants descend from the sky. Sent back to the age of ten, Ronan resolves to live a new life for the people who died for him. His classmates there include the magic department valedictorian Elizabeth de Acalusia and the merchant-minded Marya Sen Karabel. For 10 points, name this C.H. webtoon about a battle-hardened veteran reliving his student years, a Naver regression series.

Greenkyrin draws this 2026 Naver webtoon from a novel by the writer credited as Markellaha. Its narrator was transmigrated into a world he had never seen or read about before. For three decades he was convinced that he was living inside a classic fantasy role-playing world. He became a war hero in that world, retired, and settled in to watch the ending arrive. Instead he discovers that his entire career so far was only an opening section, and that the real story is about a school. For 10 points, name this webtoon whose title counts the long stretch before its plot actually starts, a Naver academy-fantasy series.
answer: 30 Years Since the Prologue [or 30 Years Have Passed Since the Prologue; accept Thirty Years Have Passed Since the Prologue]

question: Its publicity claims that only the purest of souls may shine as a star, and that the demon and the champion are two sides of one blade. Its protagonist spent ten years herding animals on the plains of Heiden, ten years on the battlefield, and ten years as one of history's most infamous killers. Known as the Steel Reaper, that sword master met a lonely end in an open field after a life of fire, steel and screaming. A hundred years later he is born again as the third son of a noble house in a world where the war is over. Enrolling at an academy, he sets out to become an Adventurer and to work out whether the fighting that made him a reaper meant anything. For 10 points, name this 2026 REDICE Studio webtoon of dark medieval fantasy, a Naver rebirth series.
answer: Ode of the Brave [or The Warrior's Ballad; accept The Hero's Ballad]

question: House Draker in this work descends from Terakan, who felled the evil wyrm Bahamut a thousand years earlier, and it keeps five Black Knights among the three Great Transcendent Households. Its signature art cannot be learned until aura awakening opens the lower dantian. This work's hero was the first of that house's direct bloodline to fail his awakening, drew a healer's talent instead, and was expelled from the family academy at fifteen. Earning the name Phantom of the North, he was hunted down by imperial forces while trying to stop the Emperor from taking an ancient relic. A message declaring that an Elder wyrm's soul is engraved on his will then throws Zeke Draker twenty years into the past, back to his house's training ground, the Cradle. For 10 points, name this Gon webtoon about a cast-out heir of monster-killers getting a second youth, a Kakao second-chance series.
answer: A Dragonslayer's Peerless Regression [or The Dragon Slayer's Regression on Another Level]

question: Its hero was the strongest player of his era and a master of lightning before a trusted friend killed him during a tower raid. He used up the last of his strength saving his comrades, then opened his eyes twenty years later in a far weaker body. The traitor who killed him now reigns as the top player of that new era, while the truth has been buried. Forced to climb again from the bottom, he takes an unexpected route and begins broadcasting the ascent live. His numbers rise along with his viewer count, and he shrugs off the flood of imitators copying his old persona because he is the real one. For 10 points, name this webtoon in which a betrayed tower climber turns revenge into online spectacle, a Next Level Studio series.

Lu Sheng, this work's hero, lives in Baihe City with his porter father Lu Dahai, his supermarket cashier mother Zheng Yufen, and a prodigy sister who resents him for wasting family money. Tan Zhongyu, the Bright Jade Martial Saint, founded the Seventh Saint Martial University in this work's world. Three centuries after mutated beasts overran that world, martial arts are humanity's last line of defense. Its protagonist begins dreaming himself ten millennia ahead, to an era whose training methods are thousands of times more effective than his own. Because humanity has died out by then, those breathing techniques, body-strengthening remedies and scriptures have no one left to inherit them but him. For 10 points, name this Kuaikan manhua about a mediocre student downloading the fighting arts of an empty tomorrow, a Chinese martial-arts series.
answer: Logging 10,000 Years into the Future [or Log into the Future; accept Landing 10,000 Years Into the Future]

question: The Blue Guild of the free city of Lindel is led in this work by Kim Hyunsung, with the protagonist as its vice master. Cha Heera, master of the Red Mercenary Guild and the most powerful person in that city, is called the Bloodthirsty Madame. The Holy Empire of Benigore becomes a Sacred Democracy after a revolution here, and its goddess is greedy enough to be scammed repeatedly. Lee Kiyoung is summoned into a deadly game with the worst talent of anyone, his numbers described as hopeless. His one skill lets him read other people's status screens, and that is what reveals that Kim Hyunsung has already lived through this world once. For 10 points, name this MIDNIGHT Studio webtoon about surviving a tutorial by clinging to a time-looping companion, a Kakao summoning series.
answer: Regressor Instruction Manual [or How to Use a Returner]

question: Medea Poison, one of the Seven Stars, serves as headmistress of the Joaquin school in this work. Siegfried von Nibelung, the grandfather of the student Abel and a fellow Seven-Star hero, is known worldwide as the Emperor of the blade. Other students here include Chloe Auditore da Sicilia, the granddaughter of the Old Man of the Mountain, and Rachel de Murat, niece of the Spear Saint. Leon van Reinhardt, the world's officially recognized Hero Candidate, was supposed to be the protagonist of all this. Instead the lead is Chef Kim, Korea's legendary raw-fish cutter, who lands in the mobile game Blessing M as the extra Kang Geomma and gains the Blessing of the Blade God. For 10 points, name this GMAN webtoon in which a fish-slicing knife overwhelms an elite school of heroes, a Soo Comics series.
answer: The Academy's Sashimi Sword Master [accept Sashimi Sword Master]

question: The Grandia Kingdom of this work, nicknamed the Thousand-Year Kingdom, rules the east of the continent from its capital, Grand. Felix Esperanza, the Sword Sage and Duke of Esperanza, trains this work's hero, who in turn trains the red-haired Eileen Floyd, called the Steel Rose. Its protagonist had been a middle-aged knight in an independence army, bent on revenge against the empire that executed his brother, until he blew himself up in battle. Logan McLane wakes up young again, before he has yet been disowned for his behavior, and starts recruiting talent to develop new weapons and pay for an army. Count Roger Befros, aligned with the Second Prince's faction, dies at his hands. For 10 points, name this Painkiller webtoon about the heir of a ruined noble house raising his sword against fate again, a Naver revenge series.
answer: Regressor of the Fallen Family [or A Flame Reborn]

question: Its protagonist grumbles that nobody even bothered to stick him with the soul of Zhang Sanfeng along with his second chance. Jin Sowoon opens his eyes thirty years before the Demonic Cult reappears, with no innate aptitude and only a hopeless third-rate school to call home. His single advantage is perfect recall of all he has ever seen. He remarks that coming back to the past does not exactly feel like a sign telling him to save the world. Mo Gi Yan began drawing this 2026 REDICE Studio title in Naver Webtoon from a novel by Jeokseolmok. For 10 points, name this murim webtoon whose hero's only gift is a flawless memory, a Naver regression series.
answer: The Martial Genius Who Remembers Everything [or The Unforgettable Genius Martial Artist]

question: House Zahar of Axum City in the Enril Desert is nominally ruled by Caesar, though his second-in-command Tallis, nicknamed Phoenix, actually runs it. That elder turns out to be the grandfather of this work's protagonist, who later ambushes and breaks the neck of a rival heir named Alma. In this work's world the relevant power cannot be studied for; it is inherited through bloodlines, and those who hold it outrank nobles and knights. Its hero keeps his own inherited talent hidden while tending a flock at Hisaril Hill, avoiding nobles who would exploit him. When a wandering knight spots his potential, he must choose between staying hidden and going to the capital. For 10 points, name this Watermelon Peach webtoon about an archmage disguised as a keeper of sheep, a Naver desert-fantasy series.

Ridibooks carries this 2026 webtoon, illustrated by Glee from a story credited to Hobby Writing Principle. Its world was remade by an event called the Great Cataclysm. Its protagonist Seo Jio, an ordinary art teacher, dies in a sudden fire and wakes trapped inside a portrait as part of the picture itself. Within that framed world he gains near-omnipotent abilities: he can create life and open gateways to other dimensions. Crossing countless dimensions and resolving the crises of people bound by fate, he edges closer to the truth behind his own death. For 10 points, name this webtoon about a teacher of pictures who becomes one, a Korean transmigration series.
answer: A Painter Who Draws Dungeons [or The Painter Who Draws Dungeons; accept The Artist Who Paints Dungeons]

question: Every so-called Ender in this work begins in the Head Realm, a decaying-corpse world whose edge is flat rather than curved. Its practitioners pass through stages such as Core Formation and the Four Axis, the latter of which adds fifty thousand years of life once all its axes are built. Seven modern office workers fall into a world of immortals here, among them Kim Young-hoon, the Golden Speed Heavenly King. Six of the seven manifest blessed gifts, while Seo Eun-hyun appears to have none at all. His real ability, endless repetition of his own life, is a curse rather than a blessing, and he has already ground through thousands of cycles trying to escape it. For 10 points, name this Tremendous webtoon about a man looping forever through a world of immortal sects, a Naver xianxia series.
answer: A Regressor's Tale of Cultivation [accept Regressor's Tale of Cultivation]

question: This work's hero inherits his throne from a predecessor named Ashborn and becomes the second Shadow Monarch. During a raid on Jeju Island, a monstrous ant begins slaughtering S-rank fighters one after another. In its epilogue, after the Monarchs perish, its protagonist travels back in time to save the people he lost. A decade before the main story, gates connecting Earth to a monster world opened, and those able to enter them are called Hunters. Sung Jinwoo, an E-rank hunter known as the weakest of all mankind, is chosen as the Player of a system that shows him a quest log nobody else can see. For 10 points, name this webtoon, given a 2024 A-1 Pictures anime, about a lone Korean hunter who grows stronger by clearing daily quests, a REDICE Studio series.
answer: Solo Leveling [or Na Honjaman Level Up; accept Only I Level Up]

question: The Rulers' Association in this work was founded by the Dokgo, Seomun, Namgung and Moyong clans after they walked out of the Murim Alliance, leaving the Tang clan behind. Its Hwa clan traces back to an assassin who was given a new name by the Wudang Sword Immortal. This work's protagonist once roamed the martial world relying on nothing but his bare hands before the demonic faction killed him. He wakes as Lee Jin-Eon, the eldest son of a wealthy merchant group in Anhui, a wastrel who had drunk himself to death. Backed by that house's enormous wealth and his own remembered technique, Dan Woo-Sung declares that debts must be repaid and grudges settled. For 10 points, name this webtoon from a Yu Jin-Seong novel about a bare-knuckle legend reborn as a merchant's heir, a Studio JHS murim series.
answer: Reincarnation of the Fist King [or Gwonwanghwansaeng; accept Gwonwang Hwansaeng]

question: Gusha draws this 2026 KakaoPage title from a story by Glumph. Its narrator is a dark sentient blade named Gruhorn, wielded across the ages by knights, rebels and slayers who all won fame carrying it. That weapon boasts of having raised a great knight once called invincible, the man who brought down the Mad Dragon, and a Mercenary King. Centuries after the earliest hero claimed it, it ends up in the hands of a greedy, bratty fifteen-year-old royal heir. When that worthless youth falls onto the blade, the blade takes over his body. For 10 points, name this webtoon in which a storied talking weapon possesses an empire's eldest son, a Kakao transmigration series.
answer: I Became the First Prince: Legend of Sword's Song [or I Became the First Prince; accept Became the Lout First Prince]

question: Divinities attached to this work's hero include Petos, of war and fire, and Heto, of steel and smithing. One recurring figure, Goo Daesung, has been stuck at D rank for a decade and keeps coming back each year to be retested. Blue Line Studio draws this webtoon on Naver from a novel serialized on Munpia. Leon Dragonia Lionheart spent three centuries in another world rising to become the sacred sovereign of the Lionheart realm, blessed by an entire pantheon. Back on a modern Earth wrecked by gates and monsters, he sets about restructuring hunter society along his own archaic, uncompromising code. For 10 points, name this webtoon whose protagonist hunted demons in another realm for three hundred years and did not come home alone, a Korean gate-fantasy series.
answer: The Knight King Who Returned with a God

question: Its lead is heir to the Ancient Immortal Gu family of the Upper Realm and leads the Fatian Alliance. Su Qingge, the saintess of the Taixuan Sacred Land, abandons that land's chosen one to side with him instead. Ye Chen, styled the world's protagonist and fortune's favorite, swears revenge on this work's lead in its very first chapter. Gu Changge is helped along by a system that rewards him for harvesting that chosen one's luck. His fiancee Yue Mingkong of the Celestial Wushuang Dynasty is head over heels for him, and he is treated as a distinguished guest everywhere he goes. For 10 points, name this Kuaikan manhua in which a transmigrator gleefully plays the story's designated antagonist, a Chinese cultivation series.
answer: I Am the Fated Villain [accept The Villain of Destiny]

question: The Plaza of Glory in Huiss, capital of the Roan Kingdom, is the site of a terror incident in this work. Its hero allies with the crown prince Alberu Crossman, a quarter dark elf, and is served by the former assassin Ron Molan as a butler. The Fog Cat siblings On and Hong are among the children who attach themselves to this work's protagonist. Kim Rok Soo had dozed off partway through a book called The Birth of a Hero, written by Nelan Barrow. He wakes as Cale Henituse, a minor antagonist due for a beating from the coming hero Choi Han, and adopts the motto of not getting beaten up. For 10 points, name this webtoon about a reader trying to live idly as a wine-loving young nobleman inside a novel, a Kakao transmigration series.
answer: Trash of the Count's Family [or Lout of the Count's Family; accept TCF]

question: Gal Sa-Ryang, supreme strategist of the Grand Martial Alliance, had helped its aging chief unify the central plains in this work. The servant Gwangdu is promoted into the sword squad of the Byeok clan of Shandong after his young master changes overnight. That chief, Cheon Ha-Jin, finds at seventy that he can barely recall his own famous deeds, and then dies of a mysterious ailment. He wakes in the body of Byeok Ri-Dan, a gambling-addicted disgrace who had been shut in a dark warehouse for a long time. Betrothed since before birth to Song Hwa-Rin of the Song clan, that wastrel now has to be rebuilt from nothing. For 10 points, name this webtoon in which the greatest expert of jianghu wakes as his era's worst, a Studio JHS martial-arts series.
answer: Reborn as the Heavenly Demon [or Rebirth of the Heavenly Demon; accept Reincarnated Murim Lord]

question: In his earlier career its hero abducted an executive of the Daedo Corporation who had photographed himself torturing and killing six women. The police ignored that accusation, and this hunter of human predators was shot dead after finishing his target off himself. He returns in the body of Sosam, a stable boy of the Danri Clan who was worked to exhaustion by an overseer named Ma Chil. The in-story virtual-reality game he had been logging into is so violent that watchdog groups keep demanding it be shut down. A clerical error by the Grim Reaper drops him into the real martial world rather than that game's servers. For 10 points, name this Dong Bongsu-starring 2025 Naver martial-arts webtoon series.
answer: Murim Psychopath [or Psychopath in Murim; accept Psychopath of Murim or Murim Saikopaeseu]

question: Its protagonist dies with a Holy Sword through his heart, betrayed by the sibling in whose shadow he had spent his whole career. That sibling, Aschel Vert, commands the Knights of Light and is hailed across the Ushif Empire as the Guardian of the Continent. Waking as a child again, the illegitimate Cyan Vert resolves to trust nobody and to serve nobody but himself. He later guards Arin Severus, a light-magic prodigy sidelined inside her own imperial court. Redice Studio draws the Naver adaptation of Coffee Lime's novel, which reached English readers in 2024. For 10 points, name this Cyan Vert-starring Korean second-chance webtoon series.
answer: The Regressed Son of a Duke is an Assassin [or The Reborn Young Lord Is an Assassin; accept The Regressed Youngest Son of the Duke Is an Assassin or Hoegwihan Gongjakgaui Mangnaedoryeonnimeun Amsalja]

question: Its hero was the sole survivor of the Sangdong District Gate incident, and half a year of interrogations later he lost his guild job in a reorganization. On the very day he was fired he picked up a battered virtual-reality headset and could not get back out of it. Inside, he becomes a disciple of the Fire King and befriends Cheongpung, the adopted grandson of a Huashan Sect sword saint. Strength and techniques earned in that world carry over to his body in the real one, where portals still disgorge monsters. After escaping, Jin Tae-kyung chooses to go back for the non-player characters he had come to care about. For 10 points, name this Jin Tae-kyung-starring KakaoPage virtual-reality webtoon series.

On the seventy-seventh floor a Stone of Regression was discovered, letting climbers rewind to an earlier point at the cost of splitting into a separate timeline. The dwindling holdouts who refused to abandon their own timeline banded together under the name Carpe Diem. Humans had been summoned without warning as Walkers and told that clearing a hundred-floor tower was the only way to save humanity. One by one the others left, until a single stubborn Walker was still climbing. Jaehwan, that final holdout, reaches the hundredth floor no longer sure what to believe. For 10 points, name this Jaehwan-starring Korean tower-climbing webtoon series.
answer: The World After the End [or The World After the Fall; accept TWATE or Myeolmang Ihuui Segye]

question: Its lead's alter ego bears the name Grandfell Claudi Arpeus Romeo, invented in his second year of middle school and levelled to fifty-five. Because he had built that character as a demon hunter, he becomes the only one of the class in existence and struts accordingly. Rifts start spilling monsters out of a virtual-reality game set on the Archana continent into the real one. Only people synchronized with the characters they once created can close those rifts. Lee Hoyeol, a plain salaryman, must now fight as his own excruciating creation, complete with its mannerisms and speech. For 10 points, name this Grandfell-starring Naver webtoon series.
answer: The Player Hides His Past [or The Player Hiding His Past; accept Player-ga Gwageoreul Sumgim]

question: Its hero's allies are souls from realms that have already been destroyed, bound by three principles that rank protecting their contractor above even obeying him. Among them are John Kozak, a murderer who ties red ribbons round his victims' heads, and Gwangma, an old martial artist called the Mad Demon. Their contractor holds the Summoning Trait and is designated the Summoner of Earth number 1001. Bong Juhyeok is twenty-five, permanently anxious, and perfectly content to stay under the radar. Black spires stuffed with monsters, danger, and the promise of fame have risen worldwide, and only a select few are picked to go inside. For 10 points, name this Bong Juhyeok-starring 2025 Naver summoner webtoon series.
answer: A Wimp’s Strategy Guide to Conquer the Tower [or A Wimp’s Tower Strategy Guide; accept A Loser’s Tower Strategy Guide or Jjijiri-ui Tap Gongryakbeop]

question: Its hero's disciple Arslan abandoned his own house to found a new one whose entire purpose was to clear his master's name. That new house's scion possesses a Heavenly Exoskeleton, a constitution that lets him store mana in his bones instead of only in his heart. Earlier, the protagonist fought with a single arm, having no right one at all, and still outstripped the direct line of the Samion house. After he spared his cousin Kazin in an honorable duel, Kazin stabbed him in the back and had him imprisoned for good. Five centuries later the minor god Yulion unknowingly summons his soul into the body of a boy named Vinchen Adenca. For 10 points, name this Vinchen Adenca-starring KakaoPage webtoon series.
answer: Standard of Reincarnation [or The Art of Reincarnation; accept The Essence of Reincarnation or Hwansaengui Jeongseok]

question: Its protagonist adopts a crimson bear cub called Beh at the request of the cub's mother, and Beh keeps growing the more he eats. The spire he is trapped inside is one of ten raised by a God of Creation as training grounds for doomed realms, nine of them handed to dragons. Stranded in a concealed area with nothing but a handful of seeds, Sejun plants crops and gathers resources to stay alive. He ends up raising and selling cash crops, tomatoes included, while knocking out quests for extravagant rewards. A gang of loyal animal companions keeps this Seoul underdog company inside the monster-filled structure that rose over his city. For 10 points, name this Sejun-starring Naver agriculture-and-monsters webtoon series.
answer: Solo Farming in the Tower [or The Top Dungeon Farmer; accept Farming in the Tower Alone or Nahonja Tabeseo Nongsa]

question: Each of its seven coloured zones holds an inheritance left behind by a fallen race, beginning with the World Tree of the Red Zone. Its Green Zone is an online-game world where humans count as exploitable bugs and are hunted by millions of respawning gamers. God is said to have created the Abyss out of sheer boredom, and humanity trapped there was headed for extinction. With only a single slot available, the four strongest survivors agreed to send the mightiest among them backwards through the years. Kang Hansoo therefore arrives just before humanity is dragged into the Abyss, carrying everything he learned there. For 10 points, name this Kang Hansoo-starring KakaoPage Abyss-climbing webtoon series.

Secret assassinations, kidnappings, and thefts of vital resources are handled in this series by the Slaughter-Seeking Squad. Its central palace grades its battle squads from the first level, which may run independent missions, down to the third, which must simply obey. Bu Eunseol infiltrates that organization after one of its members murders his grandfather. His overwhelming bloodlust makes him a prodigy in the very techniques he set out to destroy. He intends to devour the martial teachings of all ten of its constituent sects and endure any amount of bloodshed to reach the top. For 10 points, name this Bu Eunseol-starring 2025 KakaoPage revenge webtoon series.
answer: The Divine Demon’s Grand Ascension [or The Great Heavenly Demon Sovereign; accept Sinma Deongcheon-gi]

question: Its framing device follows a historian digging into the private truth behind the age's most celebrated martial hero. That hero, Wi Yeonho, is remembered as a gentleman, a fine man, and a chivalrous warrior by everyone who never met him. People who actually knew him summarize his character with the verdict that he was a complete scumbag. His training always began tomorrow, since the greatest procrastinator of the era could never quite be bothered to start today. Its source novel ran on Naver Series before this 2025 Naver Webtoon adaptation began. For 10 points, name this Wi Yeonho-centered Naver martial-arts webtoon series.
answer: Chronicles of the Lazy Sovereign [or Chronicle of the Lazy Sovereign; accept Chronicles of the Lazy Monarch or Taejon Birok]

question: Its protagonist eventually governs the Hines region, a cursed wasteland whose ancient ruins nobody had managed to explain. He also marries Illyna De Pallan, a princess called the apple of the eye of the Pallan Empire. An enemy's arrow had put this feeble prince of an insignificant country into a coma at the very start. His soul then spent a thousand years in punishing training at a hall where the souls of the mighty gather. Davey wakes in his own timeline far stronger than the plotters at his father's court expect. For 10 points, name this Prince Davey-starring KakaoPage webtoon series.
answer: The Max Level Hero has Returned [or The Max Level Hero Strikes Back; accept Max Level Hero or Mallep Yeong-ung-nimkkeseo Gwihwanhasinda]

question: Its protagonist crosses paths with Kaegal, the Master of Poison of the Nesos Guild, the empire's foremost assassination outfit. An imperial enforcer razing noble houses across the realm becomes the chief threat to his plans. Kim Yohan died in an accident in modern Korea and woke as Johann Aitz, lowest-ranked child of a prestigious house. He decides that the only person worth trusting is himself, and that money and muscle are the only things worth having. Every money-making scheme he tries keeps curdling into an act of heroism anyway. For 10 points, name this Johann Aitz-starring Redice Studio webtoon series.
answer: The Wandering Knight’s Survival Manual [or The Wandering Knight’s Survival Guide; accept How to Survive as a Wandering Knight or Bangnang Gisa-ui Saengjonbeop]

question: Its hero's followers are ranked as vassals, among them the spearman Ha Dong-geon, who holds the sixth seat. His fortified flat in Busan grows into a refuge simply called the Haven as more survivors arrive. The catch on his awakened talent is brutally simple: inside his dwelling he is untouchable, but he cannot step outside it. The recluse must therefore arm his neighbours and send them out in his place to expand his domain. Monsters have overrun the city around him, and saving his own relatives is the only reason he bothers. For 10 points, name this Kim Jae-hyun-starring Naver apocalypse webtoon series.
answer: The Ultimate Shut-In [or Ultimate Shut-in; accept The Absolute Dweller or The Absolute Ruler of the House]

question: Its protagonist holds the post of head professor at the Imperial university as well as the countship of House Yukline. He takes on Epherene Luna, heir of a ruined noble line with archmage-grade talent, despite her shaky nerves. Julie von Deya-Freyden, captain of the elite Knights of Freyhem, is one of his few genuine allies. Kim Woojin, a game developer fresh off a breakup, had once tweaked this mid-boss's character sheet to make him nobler. He then woke up wearing that character's skin, with roughly a one-in-a-thousand chance of getting out in one piece. For 10 points, name this Kim Woojin-starring KakaoPage magic-academy webtoon series.
answer: A Villain’s Will to Survive [or The Villain Wants to Live; accept The Villain’s Survival Route or Akdang-ui Saengjon-gi]

question: Berje Deias died the first time around by following his job's official rulebook to the letter. He discovered that his own tower had effectively been designated a purpose-built hunting ground for the continent's champions. Given a second run through, he throws the standards of his office out entirely. His new approach goes sideways almost at once when the abduction of a princess fails to come off as planned. The hard-headed ruler of monsters now faces an entire continent's worth of chosen slayers armed only with untested methods. For 10 points, name this Berje Deias-starring 2025 Naver webtoon series.
answer: The Demon King Overrun by Heroes [or Too Many Heroes for the Demon Lord; accept The Demon King Has Too Many Heroes or Yongsadeurege Jitbalpineun Mawangnim]

question: Its hero was condemned by a being called Demigod to an eternity of slowly losing his mind. He revives four millennia later in the body of Frei Blake, the least gifted student at the prestigious Westroad Academy. He notices at once that the study of spellcraft has barely advanced in all that while, and suspects sabotage by his old jailer. Lucas Trowman had been the most accomplished caster in recorded history before that punishment. Redice Studio illustrates the KakaoPage adaptation of Nakhasan's novel, with Barnicle writing the comic. For 10 points, name this Lucas Trowman-starring KakaoPage academy-magic webtoon series.
answer: The Great Mage Returns After 4000 Years [or The Archmage Returns After 4000 Years; accept TGMR4000Y or Saman Nyeon Mane Gihwanhan Daemabeopsa]

question: Its magic system splits practitioners into Blue Circle casters, who advance by steady meditation, and Red Circle casters, whose growth feeds on volatile emotion. Reaching the ninth Circle, a rank spoken of as the province of a demigod, requires the heart of the crimson wyrm Valdrova. Valdrova hands that heart over without resisting, remarking that her own betrothed has come to finish her. Ferda Rosnova, a third child of the Rosnova house, is the one holding the blade. What he finds afterwards is a despair far older and deeper than the hatred that had driven him. For 10 points, name this Valdrova-centered 2026 Naver webtoon series.
answer: My Slain Dragon Bride [or I Married the Dragon I Killed; accept The Dragon I Killed Became My Bride or Nareul Jugin Deuraegon Sinbu]

question: This series is adapted from the setting of the online game RF Online, and its cybernetic empire is named Accretia. Its protagonist grew up in the lower districts of a setting where humanity has long since left Earth behind. At fifteen he sat the selection examinations and was assigned an aptitude for the Imperial Guard. Interstellar flight is routine in this setting, and machinery has largely replaced flesh. His friendship with Ilay, whose temperament and background are nothing like his own, reshapes both boys and eventually their planet. For 10 points, name this RF Online-derived Redice Studio science-fiction webtoon series.

Its hero's maid Djitri de Lobilia is secretly the dispossessed heir of a noble line wrecked by her own uncle. Iana von Seyder, a succubus who cannot drain mana from men, is written off as a failure by her own powerful relatives. The protagonist's in-story father, Theodore von Reinhafer, is among the most powerful men on the continent. Yoo Chan, given a fatal diagnosis as a child, had poured himself into the punishing role-playing game Inner Lunatic. He now has to survive inside it as Nox von Reinhafer, the worst antagonist of the story's first act, whose statistics start heavily debuffed. For 10 points, name this Inner Lunatic-set Naver webtoon series.
answer: Terminally-Ill Genius Dark Knight [or Time-Limited Genius Dark Knight; accept Terminally Ill Genius Dark Knight or Sihanbu Cheonjae Amheukgisa]

question: On its sixtieth floor the protagonist builds a clone of himself out of his own DNA, memories, and magic, and the copy promptly flees upstairs. He is given a long black coat with orange stripes by Kirikiri, one of the entities running his ordeal. Only about one climber in ten thousand is expected to live through the setting he picked. A selection window had offered four settings of escalating danger, and Lee Ho Jae chose the most punishing one instantly. The former professional gamer regrets that choice almost immediately. For 10 points, name this Lee Ho Jae-starring KakaoPage webtoon about surviving the highest possible difficulty.
answer: The Tutorial is Too Hard [or The Tutorial Is Too Tough; accept TTiTH or Tyutoriori Neomu Himdeureo]

question: Renee, a homunculus maid whose devotion to her employer has no discernible limit, handles his day-to-day care. A skeleton named Patrick is described as the only functioning brain cell in the entire lair. That lair, the Primordial Core, is the most infamous of seven great evil dungeons reckoned impossible to clear. Its resident, the so-called Original Creature and incarnation of evil, would much rather be asleep. Raiders keep turning up at his door, and he keeps being nagged for dozing until the humans are right in front of him. For 10 points, name this Primordial Core-set KakaoPage comedy webtoon series.
answer: Mr Devourer, Please Act Like a Final Boss [or Mr. Devourer, Please Act Like a Final Boss; accept Act Like a Boss Monster, Mr. Swallow or Posikjanim Jebal Cheojong Boseocheoreom Haengdonghae Juseyo]

question: Transcendent beings who oppose the devouring of worlds by the sources call themselves the Immoral People in this series. One of them, a fog-sea ruler nicknamed Jellyfish, becomes fixated on the protagonist and keeps interfering on Earth. After a dungeon raid goes wrong and kills his younger brother, the protagonist spends his clearance wish on resetting his own timeline. He comes back bearing the title Perfect Caregiver and a plan to keep his head down. Han Yoojin instead finds that he can turn ordinary awakened people into the strongest tier there is. For 10 points, name this Han Yoojin-starring Naver webtoon series.
answer: The S-Classes That I Raised [or The S-Ranks That I Raised; accept My S-Class Hunters or Naega Kiun S-geupdeul]

question: Before his death its protagonist was made to study and catalogue the martial techniques of four captured experts on behalf of the Blood Demon Cult. His qi centre had already been destroyed, and when that cult turned on him he took the whole organisation down with him. He wakes in the body of a young tutor at a rural training hall, carrying an illness set to kill that body within three years. The techniques stored in his memory can cure it, but doing so demands an enormous amount of money. So he goes after a lucrative post at the Azure Dragon Martial Arts Academy, and perhaps educates a few pupils along the way. For 10 points, name this Azure Dragon Academy-bound Naver murim webtoon series.
answer: Star Instructor, Master Baek [or Best Teacher Baek; accept One Hit Teacher, Master Baek or Ilta-gangsa Baeksabu]

question: Its protagonist grew up in the slums of Ebelstein and clawed his way up to become a second-tier mage. He scraped a living as a mercenary before an unexpected invitation changed his career entirely. His first pupil, Diella Duplain, is the temperamental youngest daughter of an aristocratic house who cannot use magic at all. Derek is her final option before she is packed off to a convent. His success at turning haughty heiresses into presentable people sends offers pouring in from the great aristocratic houses. For 10 points, name this Diella Duplain-tutoring Naver webtoon series.
answer: Noble Lady Reformation Guide [or The Noble Lady’s Reformation Guide; accept There’s No Such Thing as a Bad Lady or Yeongae Gaejo Jichimseo]

question: Threats in this series carry nine risk levels, set not by the odds of a successful hunt but by the hunter's odds of coming home. Its boy protagonist hunted down the creature Wadu-Scholar, which had murdered his parents, after learning its weakness rather than charging in. He then displayed the severed head, and his own village decided he was a freak and shunned him for it. A one-horned dokkaebi named Mongryeon, who hunts such creatures for a living, takes the listless boy in. Spotting something unusual in Yise, she sends him to Daemudo, a sect known as the immortal realm's executioners. For 10 points, name this Yise-starring Redice Studio webtoon series.
answer: The Tale of Cultivation and Demon Extermination [or Chronicles of the Demon-Slaying Cultivator; accept Chronicles of the Demon Slayer or Suseon-gwa Toema Iyagi]

question: The syndicate in this series ranks its enforcers as twelve Apostles serving a chairman who goes by Raphael. The first of those Apostles later hides behind the assumed identity Sun-gu Kim. An early antagonist nicknamed Octoman wears yakuza octopus tattoos running from his back up over his head. Its protagonist had retired from the Glory Club to run a quiet secondhand bookstore. Ambushed by his own former employers, he survives and finds his body restored to its teenage prime. For 10 points, name this Glory Club-battling Naver webtoon series.
answer: Killer Pietro [or Killer Peter; accept Killer Pedro or Killeo Piehroteu]

question: Humanity's last gambit in this series is a continent-spanning sealing formation meant to finish a hundred-year war in a single day. A hero named Parte and an imperial mage named Noah are dispatched to that formation's final anchor point. There they meet Roro, a young shepherd boy working near the site. With the three of them in place, the grand plan stands on the verge of completion. Then, on the day of the ritual, everything is turned upside down. For 10 points, name this Roro-starring 2026 Naver webtoon series.

Its cast includes Hwaran, a living jiangshi fused together from a girl's original soul and the corpse her own father reanimated. Marié Dunareff, heir to vast southern plantations, is the strongest second-year at the school where it is set. Its narrator, Corin Loque, is a minor supporting figure who nonetheless knows the game's script cold. He watches the protagonist Sihu murder harmless background characters in order to loot their equipment. When Sihu inexplicably fails the last mission, Corin is thrown three years into the past to take over the role himself. For 10 points, name this Corin Loque-narrated Naver webtoon series.
answer: I Killed an Academy Player [or I Killed the Player of the Academy; accept I Killed the Main Player or Akademi Peulleieoreul Jugyeotda]

question: Its hero and his sworn friend Hyeonjo had built their friendship by repeatedly crossing blades despite belonging to opposed factions. A surprise attack by the Demonic Cult leaves both men cornered and about to die. Dying, Hyeonjo presses the Plum Blossom Spirit Beads, a sacred relic of his school, into his friend's hands. Those beads transfer Dokgo Heon's soul into Muhwi, one of Hyeonjo's own disciples. As his school's senior disciple he now has to honour a dying wish and rebuild a battered order. For 10 points, name this Muhwi-starring 2025 Naver murim webtoon series.
answer: Mount Hua Sect’s Genius Phantom Swordsman [or The Genius Swordsman of Mount Hua; accept Mount Hua’s Genius Phantom Swordsman or Hwasanpa-ui Cheonjae Hwanyeonggeomsa]

question: Its protagonist spent half a year as a fugitive before he was finally cornered. He was then executed as a sacrifice staged purely to inflate the reputation of a holy knight. Dying in bitter regret, Eugene is offered a chance to go back to before any of it happened. He vows never to die that way again and never to regret anything a second time, whatever it costs. Its source novel, serialized on KakaoPage, is titled in Korean as a manual for living as a vampire lord. Redice Studio draws this 2025 KakaoPage webtoon, adapted from a novel by Kim Hyungjun. For 10 points, name this Eugene-starring 2025 KakaoPage vampire webtoon series.

Its in-universe employer, Daydream Incorporated, advertises insane benefits and disclaims liability for any injuries or fatalities suffered on duty. The protagonist had taken a precious day of leave to attend a pop-up event for a modern-fantasy property he loved. He woke up inside that setting as a freshly hired employee of a famous conglomerate. The salary is excellent, the perks are absurd, and his supervisors are kind and competent. Using what he remembers of the plot, he is promoted at lightning speed and hates every minute of it. For 10 points, name this office-horror 2026 KakaoPage webtoon series.
answer: Got Dropped into a Ghost Story, Still Gotta Work [or Even if I Fall into a Ghost Story, I Still Have to Work; accept Even if I Fall Into a Ghost Story, I Still Have to Go to Work or Goedame Tteoreojyeodo Chulgeuneun Haeya Hae]

question: The body its protagonist wakes in had belonged to a young man who killed himself rather than be drafted into a war. That household is overshadowed by its second son, and its eldest is written off across the continent of Salamander as an idiot. Chris, a one-time prodigy who becomes his second sword, climbs from a two-star aura knight to a six-star one under his command. Its hero had previously ruled a murim cult as its overlord before turning up in a western-style empire. Roman Dmitri decides that the opinions of this new world are entirely irrelevant to him. For 10 points, name this Roman Dmitri-starring Naver webtoon series.
answer: The Heavenly Demon Can’t Live a Normal Life [or Descended from Divinity; accept The Heavenly Demon Can’t Live an Ordinary Life or Cheonmaneun Pyeongbeomhage Sal Su Eopda; do not accept or prompt on “The Heavenly Demon Wants a Quiet Life”]

question: Its protagonist is the only practitioner of his particular craft still alive anywhere on the planet. Earth itself was forcibly terraformed here, boiling away the oceans and burying the land under endless dunes. The survivors have hung a nickname on Zeon that casts him as a wraith of those dunes. He declares that his weapon is the entire arid expanse he walks across. Woo-Gak, who also wrote Reaper of the Drifting Moon, supplies the story for Studio SOZO's artwork. For 10 points, name this Zeon-starring 2026 KakaoPage post-apocalyptic webtoon series.
answer: Sandmancer of the Scorched Desert [or Sand Mage of the Burnt Desert; accept The Sand Mage of the Scorched Desert or Yeolsa-ui Moresulsa]

question: Its protagonist was an ordinary Korean high school senior before being yanked without warning into another world. There he mastered black magic and eventually saved that world outright. Kim Minjun walked away from the wealth and glory owed to a saviour in order to get home to Earth. Back home, a dungeon break spills monsters into his newly comfortable routine. Worse, his conscription notice comes due the very next morning, so the saviour of a world reports for basic training. For 10 points, name this Kim Minjun-starring Naver military webtoon series.
answer: The Dark Mage’s Return to Enlistment [or Returned to the Day I Joined the Army; accept The Dark Mage Enlists Again or Gwihwanhaessneunde Ibdae Jeonnalida]

question: Its hero was born with a talent that should have put his name in the history books. Instead the archlich Dorgo transformed him into an undead thrall and used him as a slave. Under that control he butchered his own relatives with his own hands and helped ruin kingdom after kingdom. Demian Haxen regains his mind only when the world is nearly lost, and is then thrown back to before any of it began. His neighbours now marvel that the household troublemaker has turned into a devoted son and brother. For 10 points, name this Demian Haxen-starring D&C Webtoon regression series.
answer: Return of the Apocalypse-Class Death Knight [or Return of the Calamity-Class Death Knight; accept The Apocalypse-Level Death Knight Returns or Jongmalgeup Desu Naiteuga Gwihanhaseotda]

question: Its protagonist adopts the online handle Almond and grows famous partly because his in-game character looks like a total beginner. An injury had ended his competitive career just as he was being tipped for greatness. His coach found him a stable job afterwards, but he never felt he belonged in it. At twenty-eight, with no degree and no employment, he gambles on broadcasting his gameplay instead. His signature trick is dropping raid bosses with a single well-placed shot from a bow. For 10 points, name this Yoo Sanghyun-starring KakaoPage gaming webtoon series.
answer: Genius Archer’s Streaming [or Genius Archer’s Livestreaming; accept Genius Archer Streamer or Cheonjae Gungsu-ui Seuteureoming]

question: Its hero's ancestor Liam Karavan, long written off as a legend, appears to him as a guiding spirit. Liam reveals the bloodline's true gift: consuming a blade lets you inherit both the strength and the memories stored inside it. Arhan needs that gift because in this setting only a peerless blade master can kill another. He had lost everyone dear to him to just such a master, and never learned why. Each weapon he absorbs brings the forgotten Karavan name one step closer to resounding again. For 10 points, name this Arhan Karavan-starring 2025 Naver revenge webtoon series.
answer: Sword-Devouring Swordmaster [or The Sword-Eating Swordmaster; accept Sword-Eating Swordsman or Geom-eul Meogneun Geomsa]

question: Its protagonist founded tenth-circle magic and ruled the Antares Empire as its archmage-emperor. Because he sheltered otherworldly species in a setting where humans buy and sell them as slaves, the continent branded him a dark overlord. A party of champions came for him, and although he maimed several of them he fell to the strongest of the group. A last-resort spell folding space and the flow of hours drops Rifenhardt into the past. He wakes there inside the body of the very bruiser who had killed him, keeping his own memories and spellcraft. For 10 points, name this Rifenhardt-starring KakaoPage regression webtoon series.
answer: The Indomitable Martial King [or The Reincarnated King of Fists; accept Time Slip of the Fist King or Bulgurui Muwang]

question: The game at its centre adapts a romance-fantasy novel called Don't Love the Unfortunate Princess, whose heroine Eizel Morf attends the same school. Its protagonist was the only person ever to beat that game's final boss, the Thirteenth Moon of the Black Night. He was then pulled inside as the character he always used, a boy who shares his own name and face. Baek Yuseol's single ability is a short hop of three to ten metres that other players dismiss as garbage. Stella, the school full of prodigies where he enrols, offers him no other route to the story's true ending. For 10 points, name this Baek Yuseol-starring KakaoPage Stella-set webtoon series.
answer: Magic Academy’s Genius Blinker [or Blink Master of the Magic Academy; accept Magic Academy’s Genius Jumper or Mabeop Akademi-ui Cheonjae Jeompeo]

question: Its hero's first companion, Lou, came as a reward for a flawless score on a job test and calls him an idiot on sight. A second one, Elle, was found as a white blade with a wooden handle stuck in the ground of an F-class gate.
