These personalities, called Egos, turn out to be the only way its protagonist can raise his own statistics. Kim Gigyu had awakened at eighteen and cleared the introductory trial, only to stay stuck on the bottom rung. Killing a goblin a day for five straight years changed nothing about that number. For 10 points, name this Kim Gigyu-starring KakaoPage tower webtoon series.
answer: Player Who Can’t Level Up [or The Player Who Can’t Level Up; accept The Player That Can’t Level Up or Rebeleop Moshaneun Peulleieo]

question: Its protagonist took the throne of the Variel Empire young, only to be imprisoned when his own nephew rebelled. A wizard named Naum saved him with forbidden magic that reaches a full century across. He wakes a hundred years earlier in the body of a child of a border-count's house that was extinct in his own era. That child is about to be handed over to a desert tribe under the terms of a political treaty. The transplanted ruler must now gather allies and unpick the conspiracies closing in around him. For 10 points, name this Variel Empire-centered KakaoPage webtoon series.
answer: Margrave’s Bastard Son was The Emperor [or The Margrave’s Bastard Son Was the Emperor; accept Ian the Illegitimate Son Was an Emperor or Byeongyeongbaek Seojaneun Hwangjeyeotda]

question: Its protagonist studied agricultural science before escaping his coursework into the fantasy game Paladins of Blood. He wakes inside that game as its final boss, the one enemy he himself had raised a hero to defeat. Invading the human realm means dying to that maxed-out champion. Refusing to invade means being eaten by his own starving generals. Jangcheol Kim concludes that the only survivable option is to grow food, ideally potatoes. For 10 points, name this potato-growing Naver webtoon series.
answer: What a Bountiful Harvest, Demon Lord! [or It’s a Bountiful Harvest, Demon Lord!; accept Bountiful Harvest Demon Lord or Pungjag-ieyo, Mawangnim]

question: The ability at its centre, Predation, originally belonged to Hagye, an Underworld ruler who had been reborn over a thousand times. Seven Archdukes of the Abyss rank directly beneath that being, each governing a domain of darkness. Its protagonist spent thirty-five years unawakened, hauling packs for monster-hunting parties and absorbing everyone's contempt. At the moment of his death a strange crowned being offers him a bargain. Kim Taehyun wakes as a high schooler with Gluttony, which lets him block and swallow other people's skills. For 10 points, name this Kim Taehyun-starring Naver Gluttony-skill webtoon series.
answer: Regressing with the King’s Power [or Returned by the King; accept Return to the King’s Power or Wang-ui Him-euro Hoegwihanda]

question: Its hero carries the Eyes of Equilibrium, one of three Authorities he stole from the Archduke Baal. Another Authority rewinds the planet every time he dies or the world collapses. Yu Jitae counts seven serious attempts at saving Earth, though the loop has actually run well over a thousand times. The catastrophe he cannot stop began when four bored young wyrms came down to Earth for amusement. This time round he decides to adopt them into his household rather than fight them. For 10 points, name this Yu Jitae-starring KakaoPage time-loop webtoon series.
answer: Kidnapped Dragons [or How to Kidnap a Dragon; accept Dragonnap or Napchidoen Deuraegondeul]

question: The Shaolin Temple of this series is the strongest member of its Orthodox Alliance and is nicknamed the North Star of Mount Tai. Its protagonist notices that the temple's monks have wrecked their own bodies through generations of incorrect training. He responds with low-frequency and infrared therapies powered by internal energy, plus some proper modern exercise form. His gym in the modern world had collapsed during a pandemic before he was pulled into a web novel. Mu Jin therefore counts down the days until his temple gymnasium opens for business. For 10 points, name this Shaolin-set Naver webtoon series.
answer: Genius Martial Arts Trainer [or The Genius Murim Fitness Trainer; accept Genius Martial Arts Instructor or Cheonjae Mugong Gyogwan]

question: Representatives of the one realm with no special abilities are dragged into this series' arena and nearly crushed on arrival. They are then handed a system prompt reading that the abilities of their game characters have been synchronized. Defeat in its tournament means the annihilation of the loser's home universe. Heavenly Demons, hunters, giant robots, demonic sovereigns, and superhumans all compete here, each staking an entire dimension. Shin Jahyeon leads the powerless delegation, armed with nothing but what he knows from video games. For 10 points, name this Shin Jahyeon-starring 2026 Naver multiverse-tournament series.
answer: War of Extinction [or Battle for the World’s End]

question: Its protagonist spent a decade loosing hordes of the risen dead across the continent before anyone stopped him. The hero Berkel Reinland finally killed him with a blade, ending that reign of terror. Two centuries and eight generations later, an infant born into Reinland's own house shouts out his old summoning chant. That chant orders the wardens of darkness, his servants and his soldiers, to heed his command. Archimond must therefore survive his own infancy inside the household of his mortal enemy. For 10 points, name this Noblesse-artist-drawn 2026 Naver webtoon series.
answer: Sword of the Undying [or The Necromancer of a Swordsmanship Family; accept The Necromancer of the Renowned Sword Family or Bulsa-ui Geom]

question: Its hero's weapon, called Lukia, flares with enormous energy at the moment of his death and hurls him backwards through the years. He wakes in the stable where he had lived as a child, back in a young body. Joshua Sanders had broken the assumption that a master of chivalry must fight with a blade. He had ended his empire's brutal civil war fighting in the service of a friend who happened to be its reigning ruler. He was nonetheless cut down by the hand of the very sovereign he had served. For 10 points, name this Joshua Sanders-starring KakaoPage revenge webtoon series.
answer: Return of The Unrivaled Spear Knight [or The Legendary Spearman Returns; accept Return of the Greatest Lancer or Mujeok-ui Changgisa Hoegwihada]

question: Its hero had been humanity's final savior, an emperor named for the alloy he consumes, before he died. Hoping to change the future, he goes back to the last place he would have chosen for himself. He is appalled to find himself back in uniform, of all places, doing compulsory service. He grows in strength at an express rate by staging a mukbang of scrap metal. Corporal Lee Hyunwook pursues his revenge on a diet no quartermaster would sign off on. For 10 points, name this metal-munching Naver webtoon series.
answer: Steel-Eating Player [or The Player Who Eats Steel; accept Steel-Devouring Player or Gangcheoreul Meokneun Peulleieo]

question: This English-only indie release was created by Auril Gavis and drawn in two-dimensional pixel graphics. Although it was only a minor title, its illustrations looked so much like black-and-white photographs that they spread online as memes. Its thirst gauge activates only inside the labyrinth, and a player refills it simply by eating a meal. Six treasures held by the six races must be combined to open the Gate of the Abyss on its final floor. In the last surviving human city, speaking its name aloud is taboo because it can expose an evil spirit's true nature. A twenty-nine-year-old addict who had spent almost a decade failing to beat it was shown a “Tutorial Complete” message and woke up inside it as a barbarian. For 10 points, name this notoriously difficult single-player role-playing game that becomes reality in this transmigration series.

A compilation covering the rank nine variety of this drop can be read in the royal city's library. Information on any above rank eight must instead be bought from an explorers' guild. Those taken from rift guardians give basic stat bonuses about one and a half times stronger than normal, plus more than the usual two abilities. Erasing one requires a donation at a church, after which a priest hands over a blue dagger. That dagger cuts a thread of light tying the explorer to a caged monster in a pure white space. A goblin archer's version confers the passive skill Poison Arrow and an active stealth skill called Thief Step. For 10 points, give this term for the rare monster drop of this transmigration series, available for only thirty minutes after its monster dies.

A man of this name called Argoda belonged to Elisa Behenk's party and later rose again through a Call of the Dead skill. Another, called Stobe, led a plunderer team in the Witch's Forest. A friendlier one called Horge survived after telling the hero to look for a team at the guild. The first bearer of the name offered to be the hero's nighttime companion on the labyrinth's first floor, proved to be a raider, and was beaten to death with the edge of a shield. That killing was the hero's first murder and started the pattern, which is unlucky for him because the name is very common in this world. For 10 points, give this name for the running jinx of this transmigration series, by which every man sharing one ordinary given name brings the protagonist a fresh disaster.
answer: the Curse of Hans [or the Hans Curse; accept Hans]

question: No. 9425, the Ring of the Frost Spirit, drops only in rifts below the third floor and seals the abilities granted by one monster power its wearer has absorbed. No. 9999, Beginner's Luck, is a flower-shaped talisman that binds forever to the first person who touches it and cannot be transferred. Twelve of these are talismans, and an explorer may use only one talisman at a time. They can be obtained only from a rift guardian, and each carries a unique special ability. Apart from crafting and discovery, they were the sole way to create equipment in the game the hero once played. The Gold Soul Repository beneath the royal Palace of Glory holds the triple-digit ones. For 10 points, give this term for the rare rift-drop equipment of this transmigration series, each identified by a serial code.

Its District 1 is the royal capital of Karnon, which no commoner may enter without permission. Districts 2 through 5, together called Kommelby, wrap around that capital like a belt and house its artisans, shops and middle class. Its District 6 is a farming area called Gnome Tree, created on the holy land of the dragon tribe and worked largely by fairies. Long ago a witch poisoned the world's air and water, and only the collective might of its wizards held that curse at bay. Every race then settled here, and survivors flocked to this fourteen-district stronghold after the apocalypse, making it humanity's final home. Its wizards later created the labyrinth, whose magic stones alchemy turns into wheat, clay, iron ore and mythril. For 10 points, name this last surviving city of the world, the setting of this transmigration series.

This event wiped out the lineage of Baek Hye-hyang, so a later blood demon secretly hunted a second bloodline said to hold the Blood Heavenly Sura Arts. The faction that lost the most in it could never meaningfully recover, and its survivors founded the clans known as the Heavenly, Earth and Moon Veins. Survivors of one crimson cult afterwards joined other unorthodox clans to form the Evil Alliance, while the Murim Alliance rebuilt itself in its original form. It began when Mokgan used sorcerous techniques to drive countless demonic beasts, and even reclusive spiritual beasts, into a frenzy. Roughly eighty percent of all martial arts masters died as those beasts rampaged across the Central Plains, causing a worldwide regression in martial arts. For 10 points, name this apocalypse that closed the Old Murim Era and opened the dark age called the New Murim Era in this wuxia series.

Yooho administers its court of five departments, one of which is run by Sa Mabyeong and another by the herbalist Man Pagok. It keeps branches at Hangzhou and Cheongsong, and counts the Blood Immortal Cult among its enemies. Its headquarters sit in an active volcanic region, and it is allied with the Dark Deity house of healers. It took its present name from the nickname of Jaegal Lin, the sole survivor of a fallen clan whose family practice it used to be. It is reckoned one of the top three houses of healing in all of Jianghu, alongside Hwaju, whose teaching method is beatings. Once expected to die out, it was revived by a transmigrated surgeon who founded and heads its surgery department. For 10 points, name this institution of this murim series, famous for acupuncture and for its warriors' skill with the five-element techniques.
answer: the White Qilin Medical Hall [or the White Dragon Clinic; accept the White Qilin Medical Pavilion or the White Dragon Medical Pavilion]

question: Waste from this place travels along an underground sewage canal to a sludge treatment facility, where Solitas incinerates it once a day. Its people may live in the Honeypot Apartments, condensed housing that becomes impenetrable once its main gates close. Its food comes largely from the Maritz Wetlands and from terrace farms, and its houses were fitted with ondol underfloor heating on its lord's instruction. Fuel for that heating comes from a black coal mine at the base of a nearby mountain. Lying in eastern Lorasia under Empress Alicia Termina Magentano, it was raised in rank in episode 66 for monumental feats of engineering. Its debt-ridden ruling family is fronted by a lazy, hard-drinking noble whose body has been taken over by a transmigrated civil engineering student. For 10 points, name this fief along the River Prona whose redevelopment drives this webtoon.
answer: the Barony of Frontera [or Frontera County; accept the Frontera Barony, the County of Frontera, or the Frontera Estate]

question: His own user manual asks readers to give him lots of love. He comforted a saddened fellow summon named Hamang whose abilities his master had doubted, and later copied one of his master's evil grins to bully a lazy bird into working. He leapt into danger to save the knight Javier from being crushed by a gigatitan. Red sunflower seeds let him swell from a few inches to over thirty feet. He was the first creature his master ever summoned, and he doubles as a construction assistant who often sits on that master's shoulder. He disappears once his master activates the power called “absolute”. For 10 points, name this fluffy brown hamster who serves the transmigrated lord of this webtoon.

Its Four Spirit Blood include Gulwon and Il-ryeong Hwang-heol, while a fist expert named Sahin belongs to its Spirit Squad. Its founder came from a different time axis and left his followers records of future events, along with orders to collect the cores of the Five Spirit Beasts. Based on Huangshan in Anhui, it ambushed and defeated a secret expedition sent to reclaim Jurkang Castle. That expedition included the twenty-third cult lord Cheon Yu-Jong and the nine senior council elders. Its rise turned a three-way balance among the forces of justice, the forces of evil and the demonic cult into a four-way deadlock. It was finally crippled by the young heir whose body hosts a device injected by a descendant from the distant future. For 10 points, name this faction of followers of an immortal, time-traveling swordsman, the chief antagonists of this murim series.
answer: the Blade God Six Martial Clan [or the Six-Blade Martial School; accept the Blade God Six Martial School; prompt on Blade Six]

question: Its true founder, Ma Yeon-hwa, enrolled at the Heavenly Martial Academy because its hidden library held part of her organization's stolen heritage. It succeeds a western predecessor that an overlord of the forces of evil annihilated while trying to seize a Soul Shifting Technique rumored to grant immortality. Its members revere power, but pursue strength through brutality, violence and cruelty. Its leaders traditionally carry a sentient, possessed weapon forged by the smith Ou Yezi. Baek Moo-young held its leadership fifteenth and Baek Hye-hyang seventeenth, and their shared lineage with its sixteenth leader later faded away. That sixteenth leader is this series' protagonist, and the title he took is named for the red fluid this organization worships. For 10 points, name this fanatical religious faction of the forces of evil in this murim series.

When it touched Ha Seong-woon and Baek Hye-hyang, it circulated their vital fluid to save their lives instead of harming them. It took perverse pleasure in being licked by Seolbaek, who lacked the lineage it usually demands, and even let her carry on. Forged by the legendary smith Ou Yezi, it is one of the five yokai blades. Legend holds that it possesses whoever wields it and devours their soul. After its owner's defeat in the Great War, the orthodox alliance claimed it as a war trophy. It is the sacred relic and symbol of the leader of a fanatical crimson faction, and was carried by Baek Wol, by Baek Moo-young, and by this series' protagonist. For 10 points, name this arrogant, talking weapon that cackles about how good the red stuff tastes.

Its founder Temar built its main house in the city of Kalon, where those who aided its prosperity may bury their swords in a plot of ground. Its pureblood members inherit a Blessed Body, which lets them repeatedly perform a Decisive Move that would endanger an ordinary fighter's life. On average its members reach one star at thirteen, three stars at sixteen, and five stars at twenty. In a thousand years of its history, not one member has failed to reach one star by fourteen. It believes in combat, conquest and control, and it dominates half the world by force. It was truly a house of magic swordsmen, a fact erased by divine influence and by the Zipfel family's manipulation of history. For 10 points, name this patriarchal clan of swordmasters whose regressed fifty-sixth patriarch leads this webtoon.
answer: the Runcandel Family [or the Runcandel Clan; accept the Runcandels or Leonkandel]

question: It was built during the era of the household's founder Temar, alongside the first generation of the Black Knights. It stands in the city of Kalon and has existed ever since that household was founded. Those who contributed to that household's prosperity are honored by having their blades buried in a plot inside it. It serves as the symbol of that household's dreams and honor. It is the main house of a patriarchal clan whose purebloods are born with the Blessed Body. For 10 points, name this aptly named residence of the blade-wielding ruling family of this regression webtoon.

His creator was Solderet, and his older sister is Misha. He and that sister share a fondness for strawberry pies, which is how he came to develop feelings for Gilly Mcrolan. He is famous for fighting and often killing others of his own kind, and even Kudan feared him. Once contracted to the household's founder Temar, he now serves as guardian to that family's regressed youngest child. His aliases include Shadow Dragon, and in his true form his black scales are set off by blue shadow flames along his head and back. He is over three thousand years old and has been weakened by a damaged heart. For 10 points, name this abrasive, boisterous black dragon who befriends the hero of this regression webtoon.

This recurring event was proposed by the richer of its two participants after a war, and began as a friendly gathering held once every five years. It later became a biennial competition between second- and third-grade disciples, staged as a social occasion so that elders would not escalate matters. The host sect has always held it, while the challenger quietly paid just enough that refusing to host became impossible. The challenger dominated the duels for a century and eventually announced it wished to abolish the tradition, which would publicly rank the host beneath it. In its final staging, the host's second-grade disciples lost ten bouts in a row before its third-grade disciples won ten in a row. A regressed sword saint then proposed a tiebreaker in the form of a war of attrition. For 10 points, name this friendly contest of swords between two declining sects of the same province in this murim series.
answer: the Huazhong Contest [or the Zhongnan-Mount Hua Contest; accept the Zhongnan-Huashan Contest or the Hwazhong Contest]

question: The map to it was robbed from a man named Mu Jin by the regressed hero of this series. Located near Nanyang, it is the legendary grave of a figure known both as the Immortal Physician and as a phantom thief of blades. Rumor held that it housed many divine weapons, but after two centuries of neglect almost everything inside had rotted or rusted. It is packed with traps, so a visitor could fairly call the whole place a lethal prank. A letter left inside grants its legacy to whoever grasps its true meaning and braves its deadly perils. For 10 points, name this tomb of this murim series, whose real treasure turns out to be a healing pellet's formula.
answer: the Sword Crypt [or the Crypt of Swords; accept the Sword Graveyard]

question: Its maker was a sage and alchemist of two centuries ago who reportedly gobbled these down as if they were a common snack. Rumor holds that the recipe for it was entombed with that maker in a trap-filled grave near Nanyang. It was said to be far superior in qi-boosting potency to Shaolin's renowned Great Rejuvenation Pellets. Even a century ago, word that one had been discovered would trigger bloodshed among martial artists of the Central Plains. A letter accompanying its formula insists it be dedicated to saving the lives of countless people under the heavens. Its known users include Yao Xian and the regressed swordsman who recovered that formula. For 10 points, name this priceless medicinal pellet of this murim series.
answer: the Primordial Panacea [or Primordial Panacea pellets; accept Primordial Panacea pill]

question: Founded by Hwang Indong, it is based in the city of Xian. Its advisor Beon Jabok struck one of its elders with demonic qi, leaving him comatose for a year. That elder, Hwang Munyak, was healed by this series' regressed hero, which repaired a connection that had lapsed. It had long backed the Zhongnan Sect, but afterwards cut that support in order to invest in the hero's own sect. Extremely wealthy, it is capable of providing rewards of unimaginable size. In the past it had already saved the hero's sect from collapse, and today it manages the finances of both that sect and Hua-Um. For 10 points, name this merchant guild whose elder's recovery bankrolls the revival plot of this murim series.
answer: the Eunha Merchant Guild [or the Eunha Trading Company]

question: Its vice master Sirres Adenthem runs it in the absence of its master, who was pulled out of it by accident. Its lounge alone spans thirteen floors and can hold two hundred thousand, and most of its buildings sit at levels eighteen to twenty-two. Its members went looking for that missing master, who unusually refused to use Synthesis and never rolled a unit above four stars. He climbed anyway, staying in the server's top five, and his party ended up holding the strongest six-star heroes in the entire game. Its heroes accept that it cannot produce a hero able to reach seven stars, and know that its survival rests only on probability interference. For 10 points, name this lobby that the player nicknamed Loki ran before he was summoned into the Townia continent in this gacha series.

Led by Kaor, it was headquartered at the Zimbar estate and also operated out of the Fenris estate. Its people included Belinda, Gordon, Toran, Alfoi, Vanessa, Claude and Fergus. Relatively famous in the North for skill, it charged lower fees than rival companies because its success rate was so poor. It caused so many problems and behaved so unpredictably that completing a request was nearly impossible, which earned it a canine nickname. It stayed in business anyway, since its fighters individually matched knights-in-training and would use any means at all in combat. It was eventually dissolved and absorbed by the Fenris estate, and its members became that estate's knights. For 10 points, name this small mercenary company once served in by the regressed King of Mercenaries of this webtoon.
answer: the Cerberus Mercenary Corps [or the Cerberus Mercenaries; accept the Mad Dog Corps or the Mad Dogs]

question: They were born to humans who had been kidnapped by underground creatures and forced to live below the surface. Humans grade them by the floor they were born on, so that those from floors one to three are only slightly stronger than an adult man and usually join exploration teams. Those from floors four to six reach superhuman strength and fill out most of a raid's assault team, while those from floors seven to nine are highly respected. Anyone born below the tenth floor has strength humans cannot even understand, since mana grows denser the deeper one goes. All of them absorb and manipulate mana, which surrounds them with an aura and lets them adapt so thoroughly that they can digest rocks. When the war ended, the labyrinth masters released them, and most of them fought their way up to the surface. For 10 points, give this human nickname for the underground-born children of this manhwa, among them the protagonist Kim Jinwoo.

Paju holds six of the gates leading into it, lettered A through F, of which D, E and F are open to anyone who shows identification. Its floors below the tenth are collectively called the Abyss, and it is divided into at least twelve floors in all. Each of its floors covers a huge area at a similar depth and can hold entire ecosystems of mountains, swamps and lakes. Special structures called labyrinths sit on those floors, and its creatures eventually began pouring out through its cavern entrances. Humans fought back and seized those entrances, which are now blocked by huge doors and guarded by armed forces that register everyone entering and leaving. By the end of the war humans had mapped and almost entirely cleared its first two floors. For 10 points, name this cavernous complex hundreds of meters below the planet's surface, the setting of this manhwa.

Its new owner was greeted with a message calling him too small and inferior to bear the weight of its kingship, yet wishing its new King luck. It is themed after an ancient species thought to have lived back when Rune Magic was in use, and it lay abandoned for a long time. It stands on the ninth floor of the underground complex. Its summoned creatures include the extremely smart hero-rank maid Dominique and the warrior Quintus, who rose to hero rank after surviving many fights. Its subordinates include the elven ex-mercenary Rikshasha, who now captains its scouts, and the weretiger Hoya. An undead who rose to become a Necromancer King was beaten by its master and reincarnated inside it as a worker tending its cemetery. For 10 points, name this serpent-themed labyrinth that the protagonist of this manhwa rules as King.

Five of the ninety-nine materials it requires were exactly the ones the Gwi family could never obtain. Those five include the Divine Incense Burner of the Rising Dragon family and the Echoing Thunder Bell, whose resonating sound waves are essential. That bell sits behind the throne of the lord of the Wind Heavenly Cult, the successor beyond the borders to an older crimson cult. The list also demands the core of a ten-thousand-year fire carp, a Secret Demon Soul, and five million nyang. Researched for centuries and handed down in the Gwi family, it was considered close to impossible to use. Its true test is not the materials but the effort spent gathering them, so only someone who sacrificed everything for one goal can pass. For 10 points, name this secret method that sends its user back in time in this murim webtoon.
answer: the Great Regression Technique [or the Regression Great Technique]

question: Its cross form reaches out in four directions to speed up its rotation, though fast targets can dodge attacks from that shape unless it spins fast enough. Its detached form is not centered on its user and moves freely, so only specialized mages can control it. Users of that detached form can learn a technique called Instant Activation. Its defense form builds a deltahedron that grows tougher with each added face, while its attack form takes a star shape for fighting many enemies at once. Its basic circle form is not used for combat, and a beginner's version reaches about thirty meters. Anti-magic relies on a wavelength from a dragon's heart that disturbs it and delivers a huge shock if it reaches the mage's body. For 10 points, name this field that lets a mage see and manipulate magic through intense focus, growing larger the stronger the mage becomes.

In Heaven only giants and the Kergos use it, and Kergos who track heretics use it to launch powerful arrow attacks. Its practitioners build a diagram of their own body and manipulate it to achieve superhuman feats. Available enhancements include muscle resistance, nervous system control, mitochondrial improvement and heightened perception. A mitochondrial build strengthens every part of the body at once, but burns physical strength quickly. Stacking them costs efficiency: the base runs at one hundred percent, the next at fifty, the next at twenty-five, and so on. A user can open up to six of them, and opening more raises the efficiency of the enhancements chosen. For 10 points, name this form of magic best suited to warriors and swordsmen in this webtoon, stacked into a technique tree.

Its non-player characters are so realistic that the only sure way to tell them from players is the color of a name tag. Because it chases realism yet stays a game, subjects such as blacksmithing are far easier for ordinary players to grasp than they would be in reality. Players log in through capsules and pay a fee at regular intervals, and it has no pause function and no customer service center. Its two billion users built out its world themselves by pioneering and trading information, and its developer is barred in principle from intervening. Hundreds of television channels are filled with programs about it, and its stars enjoy more popularity than movie stars. More than one hundred and twenty thousand classes exist in it, including the legendary blacksmith class inherited by a poor young man who becomes an emperor. For 10 points, name this virtual reality game developed by the S.A Group, the setting of this webtoon.

Its class quest is started by a man named Khan and asks its holder to gather legends scattered across the continent in order to truly understand its namesake. That quest's second stage is the Great Magician's Resurrection, and a later stage asks the holder to cleanse the First Holy Sword. The quest has no time limit, and its outcome has the power to transform the game world itself. Its namesake was a half-god turned yangban who contracted with the great demon Baal and received the title Duke of Fire. Its holder inherits that man's blacksmithing first and his swordsmanship later, and its drawback is having to pronounce the names of most skills aloud. It is one of the nine initial legendary classes of this series' virtual world. For 10 points, name this legendary hidden class of this webtoon, which turns its holder into a legendary blacksmith.

Created by the S.A Group under Lim Cheolho, it is an intelligent existence powered by a quantum supercomputer. It calculated in advance when major events would occur, including the creation of the first legendary class, and shared those predictions with developers. Not even the chairman of that group can override it, because all control was handed to it to guard against unintentional manipulation. It holds that people must be rewarded for their efforts, and it prefers events in which swathes of people can take part rather than a small group. It created the Refractive Dragon and used him and Hanul to counteract the world's destruction, after Rebecca and Yatan reset the world to resist it. It has issued Name Change Tickets, sent out an emoticon to express its feelings, and voiced dissatisfaction with the First Update. For 10 points, name this supercomputer overseer, nicknamed the Foreign God, that runs the virtual world of this webtoon.

Its infants are thrown into a maze of swords and must then soak in the River Styx, which flows only through its territory. That first-come, first-served ritual works only on children under one year old and leaves their bodies as hard as steel. Its surnames encode rank: Le and La mark pure-blooded main-family children, Van marks branch and illegitimate children, and the bare surname marks employees. Its motto holds that strength is justice and weakness a sin, and that beasts who cannot be tamed will die. Its members carry dog-breed names such as Pomeranian, Cane Corso and Chihuahua, and the triplets known as the Trident of Hugo belong to it. Its patriarch Hugo sent this series' protagonist to the guillotine in a previous life. For 10 points, name this iron-blooded clan of the Rok Empire on which that regressed protagonist takes revenge in this webtoon.
answer: the Baskerville Clan [or the Baskerville Family; accept the Baskervilles]

question: Its motto is “For the Empire, Through Knowledge and Valor”, and it hosts the annual National University League competitions. Walking its perimeter takes over four hours, and roughly twenty thousand students, professors and staff live on its grounds. Its central complex is built around a grand arena ringed by dormitories and lecture halls. It offers a demanding four-year program divided into two departments covering both literature and martial training. It stands in Venetior, the capital known as the City of Water, and was once led by a principal named Winston. Its students have included Dolores Quovadis, Tudor Donquixote, and three brothers of a clan whose members bear dog-breed names. For 10 points, name this most prestigious university of the Rok Empire in this revenge webtoon.

It took place roughly thirty-five years before the main story, in the early years after the empire was unified. Its plotters attacked with unparalleled ferocity, infiltrating the imperial palace and nearly succeeding in assassinating the emperor. Official records blamed a lust for power and the throne, but its instigator actually yearned for the chaos of the Warring States Era. That instigator thought peace made humans weak and complacent, and treated the coup partly as entertainment. All but one of its plotters were executed at once; the survivor, Marquis Sade, was held in solitary confinement on the ninth floor of the Nouvelle Vague prison. It shaped imperial policy for decades afterward and the lives of many characters in this revenge webtoon. For 10 points, name this failed coup d'etat, whose title counts the aristocratic houses that took part in it.
answer: the 47 People Incident [or the 47 Noble Families Incident]

question: Its creator was the root of evil, the Demon God Bauli, and its dominant race regards itself as superior to humanity. Buer guards its second level, Oriax its seventh and Amdusias its eighth, while Baal and Satan sit on its deepest level. Lettered gates open from it onto Earth, and even the weakest things that crawl out can cause heavy casualties. Lilith, Balrog and Amon all belong to it, and its Seven Archdukes are often read as the deadly sins. Its residents are beings of chaos who stand beyond mortal notions of good and evil, and among whom the strongest hold dominion. A Korean player who fell into it defeated those Archdukes and unified it, and its demons are now led by him. For 10 points, name this multi-leveled dimension of demons that the protagonist of this webtoon returned from after ten thousand years.
answer: the Nine Hells [or the Hell of Nine Skies; accept the Devildom; prompt on Hell]

question: Jang Hyun-Jae captains its first squadron, Goo Hyun-Mo its second, and Baek Hwa Yong its third. Kang Dong Hoon is among its notable members, and it counts the Red Rose Guild among its allies. Its stated goals include eliminating Chaos Players inside its country and wiping out the Demon Cult. It also defends its country's citizens from monsters and other supernatural threats, and it treats the Miir Guild as an enemy. It was created by the Korean government to enforce order among that country's awakened combatants. In raw power it is stronger than any of the five great guilds of Korea. For 10 points, name this government agency of this webtoon, which shares its name with an elite youth corps of ancient Silla.

Its gate guardian is practically invincible, and one of its labyrinths exceeds ten thousand square kilometers. Its arctic region sits at minus sixty degrees Celsius, which kills anyone there within an hour. It was a globally popular online game until players concluded within three years that it could not be cleared, nearly sinking its operator. A small band of professional players kept at it anyway, and one of them became the first to beat its fiftieth level. Twelve hours after that feat, a Reboot Update brought it to life in the real world and leaked mana everywhere. Once it was real, every relic outside it turned out to be a replica of the genuine article inside it. For 10 points, name this unfair “trash game” whose residents mistake skills for magic, the setting of this webtoon.
answer: the Tower of Trials [accept the Tower of Trial; prompt on the Tower]

question: It pays a player one hundred coins for every ten thousand views a video receives, although the rate can vary with rank. Only one view per person counts, and only viewers outside the climb count at all. Its live feature may be used only during the boss fights that come before moving to the next floor. Faking view counts is strictly forbidden, and offenders can lose their privileges, forfeit coins, or face other discipline. Viewers can follow favorites for notifications, comment on videos, and chat in real time during a live session. It exists to make the climb visible to the outside world, and coins are the main currency there. For 10 points, name this livestreaming feature of this webtoon, a fitting perk for a hero who used to be a Paprika TV streamer.

Odin once held one of these, and all of Ragnarok suffered after he lost it. One of them, associated with tyranny, was hurled onto the nineteenth floor by Baek Ilha just before he lost to Shub-Niggurath. Others are named for defeat and for pureblood, and one named for speed was previously owned by Zeus. They are divine relics, and losing even one could turn the tide of an entire war. Each grants its bearer a unique ability, and their appearances differ from one to the next. Some of the biggest wars inside this series' structure started over them, and no faction ever held two until the hero claimed three for the Veteran Company. For 10 points, name these seven head-worn relics that a climber needs in order to reach the fiftieth floor in this webtoon.

Its ranks are marked by robe color: white for official warriors, blue for senior warriors, black for squad captains, and purple for elders. Its leader wears a green robe and stands at the transcendent level. Its purple robes include Ma Yeon-jeok, the Tyrant Hero and a former leader of its Divine Sword Group. It fields seventeen sword squads, each holding roughly twenty-five to thirty-five blue robes and ten to thirty white robes. It never acts officially for the imperial family, which protects that family's honor if it loses a fight or fails to capture a target. Everyone nevertheless knows it works for the emperor, and it exists to shield ordinary civilians from the martial artists of the murim. For 10 points, name this imperially backed sect whose ranks the lightning genius Jeong Yeon-shin climbs in this regression series.

Ranked S plus, it activates automatically whenever its holder dies. It then copies one randomly selected skill from whoever killed that holder. Its obvious limitation is that the same killer cannot be milked a second time, so fresh executioners are needed. It is earned through the achievement called the Most Unsightly Envy, which demands extreme jealousy of other people. Its owner qualified because he saw himself as an extra while regarding successful hunters as main characters. That owner eventually killed himself over four thousand times in order to kick-start his first regression. For 10 points, name this first skill shown in this webtoon, whose envious title states a wish to imitate whoever has murdered its user moments earlier.
answer: I Want to Become Just Like You [accept I Want to Be Just Like You or I Want to Be Like You]

question: This designation deliberately excludes the demonic martial world, the outer regions, and the warriors of the previous generation. Its one exception is Seo Ryang, the Yama Demon God, who is counted in it even so. A vast disparity in power exists inside it, and its three strongest members are collectively called the Three Emperors. Any one of those three is strong enough to contend with three of its lower-ranked members at the same time. A vacant seat in it is never left empty for long, since the world is full of hidden dragons and crouching tigers. Figures who surpass it include the leader of the Heavenly Demon Divine Sect and the Four Palace Lords of the outer regions. For 10 points, name this ranking of the supreme figures of the orthodox fighting world in this murim series.
answer: the Ten Greatest Masters Under Heaven [or the Ten Great Masters; accept the Ten Masters]

question: It was held every year at the Martial World Alliance's headquarters in Henan. It is one of the two such events that alliance hosted. Its stated aim was to show the world newly emerging talents and see which young star shone brightest. The alliance's other goal was networking, since without the chance to forge connections the aristocratic families would have had little reason to send blood relatives. The Henan branch of the Black Night Palace was secretly wiped out by Wi Seol-Ah while she accompanied Gu Yangcheon to it. For 10 points, name this competition for young prodigies in this murim series, named for a pair of auspicious mythical creatures.
answer: the Dragon and Phoenix Tournament [or the Dragons and Phoenixes Tournament]

question: It was established by the Murim Alliance after the catastrophe that a crimson fiend inflicted on the world centuries earlier. It documents every demon's occurrences, traits, weaknesses and counterstrategies, and keeps instructors on hand to teach those topics. Admission is by invitation only, so in practice only members of well-established families and their direct relatives attend. Anyone who wants to serve in the Demon Slayers Sword Squads must graduate from its sword branch and collect a certificate. Its students split into cliques, the most influential of which gathered the young ladies of the Four Great Clans around this series' hero. Its dean is the Sword Immortal, and the rival clique was led by the Meteor Sword, Jang Seonyeon. For 10 points, name this school that nearly every noble-born fighter in this murim series passes through at least once.

It was created by a figure called the Memory Master, and its name was inspired by the training of fighting cocks. Because of its intense yang nature, it easily causes demonic possession once a practitioner's internal energy exceeds his limits. Overusing that energy can produce an obsession with qi circulation, which is bound up with the heart and mind. Its first stage, the Wood Realm, demands an unwavering mind, something its user failed to grasp in his first life. It has five stages, of which the first four resemble a chicken while the last inexplicably resembles a shelled reptile, a progression that bewilders him. He got its manual from an unknown swordsman at a secluded training ground, and after regressing he uses it to harness the yang power of the Heavenly Jade. For 10 points, name this supreme yang cultivation method of this webtoon, whose goal is immortality and immunity to blades.
answer: the Golden Turtle Carefree Art [or the Invulnerable Golden Tortoise Art; accept the Art of the Journey Through the Distant Golden Land]

question: Its user first noticed it during meditation, when a swallowed treasure devoured his elixirs at incredible speed before he even needed to cultivate. In that same session he pulled a storage box into his hand in an instant, discovering a form of telekinesis. He first named it for that treasure, the Heavenly Jade, before shortening the name. With mastery he can drag people or objects toward his hands. Its offshoot Excessive Bloodloss draws an opponent's blood out through that telekinesis, and was first used on the chief of the Guild of the Master Blade. In a fight with the merchant Geumhae he nearly killed the man by draining his qi. For 10 points, name this supreme qi art created by the regressed mad demon Lee Jaha in this webtoon.

The government and the Hero Association publicly blamed it on Djinns. In fact the Chameleon Troupe carried it out under Yi Yeonjun, on the orders of the country's president Kim Sukho. Kim Sukho arranged it because a hero had learned of his corruption, with help from the Daehyun conglomerate's president and from Yoo Yeonha's grandfather. Among the dead were eighty-seven ordinary civilians and nine heroes, one of them Jin Seyeon's father. One victim was in the ninth month of pregnancy, and her baby was spared and sent to an orphanage as the event's sole survivor. That orphan was Kim Chundong, the extra whose body this series' transmigrated protagonist occupies. For 10 points, name this covered-up monster attack on a Korean refuge, whose truth Yoo Yeonha reveals at a party at the end of this series.
answer: the Kwang-Oh Evacuation Shelter Massacre [or the Kwang-Oh Massacre; accept Gwang-O Massacre or Kwangoh Massacre]

question: Classes there run five days a week, and combat training runs on three, covering battles, monster hunts and rescue missions. Its first-year ranks descend from Veritas through Acceptance, Intelligence, Wisdom, Cultivation, Honor, Virtue, Friendship, Potential and World. Male and female students there may interact only until ten at night, and its most notable clubs are the Traveling Club and the Academics Club. Statistically fewer than half its cadets graduate without repeating a semester, and two repeated years bring expulsion. A bus circles it every ten minutes, and a Portal device allows quick travel between it and Seoul. This artificial island in the East Sea is twice the size of Yeouido and houses about fifty thousand people. For 10 points, name this geometrically named training institute where cadets aged seventeen to nineteen train as heroes in this webtoon.

These were honorary posts granted to heroes who made great contributions during Outcall and later during the Devil War. Because they were merely honorary positions carrying authority, they would have vanished into legend once all of their original holders died. The Hero Association therefore turned them into an official institution so that empty seats could be given to others. Their original holders included Shin Myungchul, Oh Jaejin, Heynckes, and the conglomerate president Chae Joochul. Ah Hae-In received one for her contributions in the fight against Baal, and Kim Suho joined later as well. Their situation is summed up in-universe as three dead, one run away, and four in hiding. For 10 points, give this celestial-sounding collective name for the most honored heroes of this webtoon.

Her pets include a cat named Hayang and a Fenrir called Ghost Wolf, and Ah Hae-In serves as her teacher. She grew out of a magic seed dropped by a monster called the Witch of Despair, an outwardly harmless young girl whom the hero sniped before she could register his presence. Feeding that seed blood would grow it into a new familiar whose personality reflected whoever donated the blood. Wanting a genuinely good donor rather than his own calculating self, the hero chose between Kim Suho and Rachel, and used Rachel's blood after saving her from an assassination. She is listed as a hero prospect and occupies the role of the hero's adoptive daughter for the rest of the story. Bright, clingy and affectionate, she is among the most consistently popular characters in the series both in-universe and among readers. For 10 points, name this summoned witch familiar created by the transmigrated protagonist of this webtoon.

Their member Radan is a Sea Godkin and is labeled for mysophobia. Yutia Bludia, also called the Daughter of Monsters and the Bloody Queen, is labeled for wrath, while Rinne is labeled for greed. Seolrang, nicknamed the Golden Flash, is labeled for pride. Deus Makalian, the youngest master knight and captain of the Solar Eclipse Knights, is labeled for sloth. All of them belong to the organization Blue Moon, whose “God” is Allan Pallatio, third son of his house. That organization is destined to kill Allan's two older brothers, both major underworld figures. For 10 points, give this collective name for the young villains whom a possessed office worker sponsors in this webtoon, hoping to keep them from turning evil.

At its second level this skill gains Shape Transformation, letting its owner freely alter the appearance and form of the soldiers it creates. Its failure rate rises with the target's statistics and with the time elapsed since death, and it may be attempted at most three times on any one body. Creatures whose flesh is made of mana are immune to it, as is anyone far stronger than its user. It requires no mana at all, is triggered by a single fixed command, and can sweep a wide radius to claim hundreds of corpses at once. A Korean hunter later used it to sweep battlefields and turn hundreds of fallen enemies into an army hidden inside his own shadow. For 10 points, name this resurrection ability belonging to the Monarch of Darkness in this series, which turns slain hunters and monsters into loyal soldiers.
answer: Shadow Extraction [or Shadow Extract; accept Geurimja Chuchul; prompt on Extraction]

question: These objects were reckoned the second strongest magical weapons in the world, behind only the fangs of the King of Dragons. Their raw material was too short to be forged into a longsword, so a matched pair was made from it instead. They spent eight years gathering dust in the basement of the Scavenger Guild's headquarters before being handed over as thanks for a spared life. They add fifteen hundred to their wielder's attack and are sensitive to mana, so their power grows with the user. They were cut from the largest fang of a dragon that bit the arm of Thomas Andre during a famous American subjugation. They proved useless against the mightiest of the kings of darkness, whose servant that dragon had once been. For 10 points, name this pair of dragon-fang daggers carried by the protagonist of this series.
answer: Kamish's Wrath [or Kamish Wrath; accept Wrath of Kamish; accept Kamishui Bunno]

question: Completing it granted the title Conqueror of Adversity along with bonus statistics. Its opening instructions promised that points would accumulate the longer the participant stayed alive, and that those points were needed to rise to a higher rank. It unfolded inside a special dungeon that the System conjured for one person alone, and its penalty for failure was presumed to be death. Its participant was first offered the role of Necromancer, which immediately evolved into something hidden and far greater. That evolution let him raise the dead as obedient soldiers, though never anyone who had been stronger than himself. For 10 points, identify this trial, undertaken at level 40, by which this series' hero became the Monarch of Shadows.
answer: the Job Change Quest [or Job Change; accept Job Quest; accept Second Job Advancement]

question: Each of them secretly received a share of power from the angelic beings who oppose the kings of darkness. Clearing at least one S-rank gate is treated as the bare minimum for anyone hoping to join them. They live like royalty, answer to nobody but themselves, and each wields the skill Spiritual Body Manifestation. The four men who hold this standing are ranked against one another by accumulated points, and the top three are Thomas Andre, Liu Zhigang, and Christopher Reed. The five awakened who slew the dragon Kamish were granted authority equal to that of an entire country, which is how the standing was born. For 10 points, give this designation for the handful of figures in this series who are each reckoned the equal of a country's whole army.
answer: National Level Hunters [or National Level Hunter; accept National Power Level Hunters or national-rank hunters or Gukgagwollyeokgeup Heonteo]

question: It is described as a large ornamental chalice with yellow trim, indigo glass, and a light blue stem. Created eons ago by the Absolute Being, it was seized by the angelic warriors who murdered him and took his place as gods. Each use turns the clock back exactly ten years, but its power is finite and its owners noticed it wearing out. Its effect spares the warring immortals on both sides, who keep their powers and their memories of the erased timeline. Ten years before the main story, its owners resorted to spawning gates and magic beasts so that humanity could survive their war without it. This series' hero spent its last charge to bring back everyone he had lost, knowing that nobody would remember him afterward. For 10 points, name this artifact used by the Rulers to reset Earth ten years at a time.
answer: the Cup of Reincarnation [accept Reincarnation Cup or Chalice of Reincarnation]

question: Its author wrote under the pen name tls123. Its 3,149 chapters appeared almost daily over thirteen years, though its readership shrank steadily until a single subscriber remained. It begins at its hero's third repetition of time, and its plot is driven by his need to make that same journey over and over. Its events are governed by a network of channels that charges distant viewers for the right to watch, and its characters must clear graded challenges to advance. An office worker who had followed it to the final chapter found its opening challenge unfolding around him on a subway train. For 10 points, name this in-universe web novel whose only reader becomes the narrator of this series.
answer: Ways of Survival [or Three Ways to Survive in a Ruined World; accept WOS or TWSA; accept Three Ways to Survive the Apocalypse]

question: Its true form is said to be a boy in a fedora with a sad, pure face, who had grown younger over time under the weight of existence. Beings it devours are broken down into their narratives and wake inside a library, where the worthiest of them become librarians. It hides its owner's real face, leaving him so forgettable and plain that he has been called the ugliest king. It also blocks his attribute display from every viewer, including himself, concealing the one entry that would give him away. It numbs pain and mental attacks and lets him treat everything around him as fiction, weakening only when he meets someone from his ordinary past. For 10 points, name this protective skill of this series' narrator, whose title refers to the barrier a performer breaks by addressing the audience.
answer: the Fourth Wall [or 4th Wall; accept Je 4 ui Byeok]

question: Its Seoul branch office is run by an agent who took over after his predecessor left. Under its rule Earth is designated planetary system 8612, and every world it touches receives a free trial period before the paid service begins. Subscribers in distant galaxies pay to watch humans struggle, and its agents negotiate rewards and penalties with them. It has neither a beginning nor an end, and it received its present name only after a certain king took authority over the Final Wall. Its inhabitants must clear graded challenges, which come in main, sub, hidden, and bounty varieties. For 10 points, name this vast system of channels that governs the apocalypse in this series, and whose title evokes a river of lights in the night sky.
answer: the Star Stream [or Byeoldure Sinyu; accept Stream of Stars]

question: One version of it holds a magnificent black temple copied from the Nameless Temple, ringed by a legion of silent shadows. In this series' hero it is a dark, lightless expanse where shapeless forms drift, and those forms defend him against anyone who tries to seize his body. The number of suns hanging over one of these shows how many cores its owner has, and therefore his class. In a companion of his, a calm ocean glows beneath golden clouds with seven suns above it. One of these forms when an aspirant survives a first ordeal and is reborn stronger, faster, and healthier. Summoned equipment is dissolved and stored inside it, slowly repairing itself there. For 10 points, give the term for this internal reservoir that stores summoned equipment and reflects its owner's cores.
answer: the Soul Sea [accept Sea of Soul or Sea of the Soul]

question: Its monster, an awakened tyrant over four meters tall, has five milky white eyes and four arms, two of which end in bone claws. That creature turns the corpses of those it kills into dormant beasts known as its larvae. While it was under way, rocks and heavy shards of ice rained down on the participants. This series' hero entered his in the body of a shackled temple slave whose skin markings marked him as the property of a forgotten god. He came out of it with a final appraisal of Glorious and the true name Lost from Light. Anyone the magical infection has claimed is dragged into one of these after a week of fighting off the urge to sleep. For 10 points, give the term for this opening ordeal that every sleeper in this series must survive.

Mastering the legacy attached to one of these earns a relic powerful enough that whole clans have been founded around a single such item. Every rank its carrier gains adds another ability tied to it, with dormant, awakened, and ascended tiers giving way to a transformation at the highest level. Unlike almost everything else in its setting, it belongs to the person rather than to the magic that grants it. They are usually sorted into combat and utility kinds, the latter useless in a fight yet prized by society. Every one of them is unique to its holder, though relatives often awaken similar ones. Whoever receives one also receives a Flaw, a personal curse that is the price of magical power. For 10 points, name this magical specialization that this series' sleepers gain after surviving their first ordeal.

It was prompted by irregularities in the Obel Scale appearing for a second time, and the government spent two years preparing for it. Unlike the earlier crisis it involved no single gargantuan portal, but a chain reaction of hundreds of smaller ones. Thousands of Awakened crossed the Dream Realm in a quiet exodus while their bodies were shipped to ports and sealed inside sleeping pods. Members of the First Evacuation Army sheltered in better-defended citadels, some run by the government and others impregnable legacy strongholds such as Bastion and Ravenheart. The chain of portals it confronted also spread the magical infection to unusually many teenagers, and even to people past the usual age. For 10 points, name this vast military operation in this series, fought on the coldest continent on Earth.

Absorbing the lake of the dragon Maxillienne made it three times stronger and left four black droplets tattooed on each side of its owner's collarbone. It had rested in Grey Eye Lake before this series' hero claimed it as the sixth of his hidden gifts. Its original holder was born a slave and freed by the God of War, who then bound her with a title and a duty she had never chosen. After the Sekka household drove her from the Paerun Kingdom, that god took back the river she had made. When its owner traveled to the Central Plains, this was the gift that was sealed most heavily, which marked it as his most destructive. It lets him raise pillars and hurl spears made of liquid. For 10 points, name this water-based hidden gift that raises liquid pillars and spears for its owner.

Its induction ceremonies are held monthly early in the year and then weekly as the winter solstice approaches, because the rate of infection is hopelessly chaotic. It stands in the Siege Capital of the Northern Quadrant and is the only government-funded school of its kind on Earth. Built as a city within a city, it has a high alloy wall, a deep moat, and heavy turrets arranged to create a deadly air-suppression dome. Roughly a thousand young people a year pass through it, receiving food, lodging, and a wide choice of preparatory classes. Each of its dormitory rooms has an adjoining meditation space and an individual sleeping pod. For 10 points, name this state-run institution where this series' sleepers are trained before their first descent into the ruined otherworld.

Designing one requires three separate tasks: forging the item, binding it, and choosing its enchantments. For the one he built, this series' hero found mystical ice shards in the Brilliant Emporium because they suited a radiant lineage descended from a sun god. He could copy nearly every enchantment of the Mantle of the Underworld except the one naming its bearer a prince. He also considered the Unseen enchantment of the Moonlight Shard, which makes a ghostly stiletto appear with no delay at all. He resolved instead to design new enchantments, treating the job as a watershed in his growth as a sorcerer. To tailor it properly he had to watch its recipient's true fighting art rather than the imitation she used to deceive her clan. For 10 points, give the term for such an item in this series, a summonable memory tied so closely to its owner that it is exactly as strong as she is.

Human-made examples of these, such as those devised by Nelan Barrow, are weaker than the ones whose affinity came straight from nature. When their holder dies, they come to rest inside a special object or place until someone else claims them. Collecting more than one usually kills a person horribly, since a human body cannot bear the strain of several at once. To hold several of differing attributes safely, one must gather all five natural elements, earth, fire, wind, wood, and water, and so reach a state of balance. They become complete only when a soul fully absorbs them, and this series' hero still hears the voices of his because he refuses to swallow their wills. For 10 points, give the term for these hidden gifts from a bygone age, each won by overcoming a trial.

Its original holder found a hidden path to the Eastern continent that only monsters could pass, which mutated them as they crossed, and he sealed it with his own strength. That holder, orphaned young, was a legendary guardian whose stated dream was three hearty meals a day and sleep without worry. He raised a grand villa deep in the Forest of Darkness so that his friends' successors would not arrive at a shabby place. This series' hero acquired it in that villa simply by eating a pebble. It raises spears of earth from the ground and makes its user's body unbreakable, but only while he is shielding someone else. He first used it at the Gorge of Death, willing to die to save two children from a berserk half-dragon. For 10 points, name this earth-based defensive gift that becomes unbreakable while its owner shields someone else.
answer: the Super Rock [accept Guardian of Boulder or Scary Giant Cobblestone]

question: The alchemists' towers of the Mogoru Empire experimented with it on people, killed people to harvest it, and built a bomb out of it. Rei Stecker amputated his own hand after it was tainted by this substance. A human who survives absorbing it may become either a necromancer or a black mage, though the pain never leaves him afterward. It appears as a gas or as an easily evaporated black liquid. Races with the darkness attribute use it to work magic, while it poisons everyone else, dyeing them black as they die. This series' hero passed a small amount of a dragon's version of it to a certain crown prince, multiplying that prince's strength several times over. For 10 points, give the term for this poisonous magical energy, produced by creatures that are no longer alive.

It is the one thing the White Crown fears, and controlling that artifact requires it. Its bearer obtained it from the Black Bone Dragon in a swamp inside the Forest of Darkness, having previously belonged to Nelan Barrow. An elder dragon judged it the equal of a grown dragon's Fear, and its presence reminded one whale princess of her father, the Whale King. It does nothing but radiate terror, which makes it useless against a true warrior yet perfect for the confidence tricks its owner prefers. Its own voice told him that to master someone is to take everything from him, even his breath, and that fear is the easiest way to do it. For 10 points, name this hidden gift whose terror can force weaker beings to submit without a fight.
answer: the Dominating Aura [or Dominant Aura; accept Fear of Chaos]

question: Its founder demonstrated that instant death still works during the Day of Great Harmony even though ordinary injuries heal, and the first execution followed at once. It was created in the third round, and its commander, Park Jung-ah, handles all of its paperwork. Kim Min-hyuk, its captain for the normal setting, is widely regarded as the group's real leader. Its strike divisions exist to step in first and contain unexpected trouble during large gatherings such as tournaments. Its rules forbid violence against another person, theft, and any violation of another's freedom. For 10 points, name this organization that enforced rules and contained trouble inside the hundred-floor tutorial.
answer: the Order of Vigilance [accept Vigilance Order; accept Vigilante Order]

question: A cure for it can be produced from the synergy between Qin Shi Huang's elixir plant and the treasure of Xufu. Patients left untreated for a long time end up infertile. Its stranger forms include soul swapping and self-harm, while its physical forms run from bleeding and infection to organ failure and pneumonia. Its mental forms include hallucinations, withdrawal into one's room, and coma. It strikes people exposed for too long to the living treasures of this series, especially those the treasures hold in contempt for leaning on affinity. A global organization concealed information about it for more than fifteen years, and exposing that secret helped bring the organization down. For 10 points, name this occupational illness of treasure hunters, caused by handling those treasures for too long.

Its executive board had access to Odin's throne Hlidskjalf, Loki's relic, and an entity called Un-Known. Its headquarters, modeled on the Burj Khalifa and named for Odin's hall, stands in Manhattan. Made up of European and North American states, it was originally meant to gather artifacts and hand them over to monopolists. The United States eventually broke away from it after absorbing more than half of its high-grade users. Roughly eighty percent of its members were exposed as corrupt and arrested thanks to this series' hero, and it was finally dismantled altogether. For 10 points, name this global organization that monopolized relics before its corruption was exposed.

Their walls bear a sacred script that only this series' hero can read, which discloses each entrance, its traps, and the identity of its master. An unwritten rule holds that whoever survives by killing everyone else takes the prize inside. The fastest route to that prize is the one with the most traps, since a shorter path always carries more of them. They may lie underground, underwater, in the air, or in another dimension entirely, and their entrances range from a cave to a public restroom. Each is the only place where its owner can use its full power, and their real purpose is to kill and torment as many people as possible. For 10 points, give the term for these trap-filled sites where relics awaken and torment intruders.

This series' protagonist sorts most of them into tiers he calls Toxic Waste, Parasite, and Fishbone, according to how much he dislikes each one. Their number includes Heiji, who contracted with Freyja and Freyr, and Kevin Hazard, who contracted with Artemis. Yang Wei's patron among them is the Jade Emperor, while Hugo Otters answers to Apollo. Each is a divine saint bound to a god matching his or her sign, and there is no clear representative among the thirteen original awakened. The protagonist himself holds the hidden thirteenth seat, that of the serpent bearer. For 10 points, name this group of contracted Saints who each answer to a god of the ecliptic.
answer: the Twelve Zodiacs [or 12 Zodiacs; accept Twelve Apostles or 12 Apostles; accept Twelve Zodiac Saints]

question: Madoc died in it at the hands of a creature that came out of a category four portal. It ended when the armies of both great clans and of the government were trapped between nightmare portals, three of which were of that same category. Each of the thousands of portals in its region connects to a Seed of Nightmare surrounding the prize at its center. Both sides used the Call to move Saints, Masters, and Awakened into forts and temporary outposts, then pushed expeditions toward a dark pyramid. Its combatants, the Song and Valor clans, were racing to claim the Tomb of Ariel and the citadel guarding it. It was fought in East Antarctica alongside the larger government operation there. For 10 points, name this clan war in this series, called after the citadel that both sides raced to seize.
answer: the Battle of the Black Skull [accept Black Skull battle or Black Skull war]

question: Its ninth form, Infinite Purgatory, gathers sword-force into a sphere said to be able to erase a mountain. Its seventh, Dead End, is a decapitating downward swing, while its first, Mana Parrying, astonished even the archwizard Sienna. Its signature trick, Ignition, wrings out extra power by straining the user's body and cores, shortening his life a little each time. Vermouth Lionheart compiled the whole set after its inventor's death and handed it to his own second son. That son became the first leader of the Black Lions, whose descendants practice it to this day. Its inventor now cringes whenever those names are shouted aloud, since he chose them himself three centuries ago. For 10 points, name this family of sword techniques in this series, called after the dead mercenary who devised them.
answer: the Hamel Style [accept Hamel Style techniques or Hamel swordsmanship]

question: The weakest of them, associated with carnage, was the first to fall to the subjugation party three centuries ago. The one associated with fury was defeated by Agaroth along with his adopted children, and then bargained to be reborn with his memories intact and his power preserved beneath the sea. The second strongest, associated with imprisonment, had once led a party sworn to destroy all of them, and took his throne only to seal a traitor and reshape the world. That traitor became the strongest of them, associated with destruction, and lost his sense of self before devouring the world. Five of these existed, and in ancient times even a human could ascend to their station through countless sacrifices. For 10 points, give the shared title held by the five supreme fiends who ruled Helmuth.
answer: the Demon Kings [or Demon King; accept Maewang; accept Devil Kings]

question: Its wisest member was an orphan abandoned in an elven forest who learned magic from the elves who raised her. Its faithful member was a saintess of the Holy Empire, while its bravest was a tribal chief's son and the first recruit. Its founder had been a slave awaiting sacrifice who stole a sword from his captors and led the other survivors out. Its last member, known to everyone as the Stupid one, was a village boy turned mercenary who joined only after losing duel after duel to that founder. This band led subjugation forces sent by every kingdom and killed three demon sovereigns in their own castles. For 10 points, name this legendary company of champions, whose foul-mouthed swordsman is reborn three centuries later into his old comrade's noble house.
answer: the Five Great Heroes [or 5 Great Heroes; accept Five Heroes or Great Five Heroes]

question: It was found in a dungeon beneath the castle of the demon lord of carnage, and neither its maker nor its earlier owner is known. Its blade bears no carving at all and gives off a soft glow, which it can still emit and even solidify when the blade is missing. It played the largest part in killing two of the five demon lords. Judging it too dangerous for anyone to hold, its owner shattered it after making peace and left only its hilt to an old comrade. Even that hilt cancels spells and cuts through every kind of energy, and its heir has slowly rebuilt the weapon from scattered shards. It was eventually revealed to belong to the mightiest demon lord, whose blood alone lets anyone wield it. For 10 points, name this divine blade that killed two demon lords before its owner shattered it.

Its citizens pay their monthly taxes not in money but in easily recovered life force, which they scarcely miss. Vast numbers of demonic beasts bound as familiars, along with undead raised by black wizards, perform all of its difficult labor. As a result its fields are covered in golden wheat whatever the season, and every citizen is guaranteed a living even without working. Three hundred years ago it was a lawless place that was fatal to anyone who was not a demon. An oath sworn between a human champion and its imprisoning sovereign turned it into a startlingly welcoming country. For 10 points, name this homeland of the demon race in this series, whose comfortable welfare state astonishes the reborn hero who once invaded it.
answer: Helmuth [accept Devildom of Helmuth or Helmuth Devildom or Demon Realm of Helmuth]

question: It and a staff called Vladimir are the only two of their kind made from a dragon's heart. That heart came from a dragon who died with the name of its eventual owner on his lips, and it was enchanted with a surviving dragon's blessing. Like the Holy Sword it chooses its own bearer, and for the two centuries after its owner vanished it refused every high-ranking magician who tried. Unlike that sword, however, its owner may deliberately hand ownership to someone else. It sharply magnifies a user's grasp of magical formulas, letting its new wielder learn spells far faster. It belonged to the wisest of the champions who slew the demon lords, a woman raised among elves. For 10 points, name this legendary staff of this series, which shares its name with a Sanskrit word for ether or sky.

In the first timeline it served as a twenty-five-year training ground for the invasion it was meant to prepare humanity against. Its colorless first region gives newcomers roughly three months free of interference from experienced adventurers. At the end of that period the survivors must gather materials and build ships to sail onward. Its seven main regions are ordered like a rainbow, from red through violet, each holding more energy than the last. Travel between them happens by finding a dimensional portal and jumping through, and nobody can ever return to a region already left. For 10 points, name this one-way dimension of seven coloured regions that humanity must cross.

One of them, a serpent coiled around a trunk, harms nobody and merely drinks the poison fed to its host. Another draws toxins in through an inside mouth and spews them out through an outside mouth, fueling the growth of every beast on that host. A third swims the sea eating the growing roots of that host, and its breathing alone raises waves and tornadoes. A cult called the Quadratus worships them, and each is powered by a fragment of a divine stone lodged in its heart. They were engineered from demonic creatures by the elven natives of the red region, and a body-stealing schemer used them to weaken the tree sheltering his rivals. Because they are meant to be endured or evaded rather than slain, they act as natural disasters for anyone crossing that region. For 10 points, name this quintet of monstrous scourges gnawing at a world tree.
answer: the Five Calamities [or 5 Calamities; accept Five Great Calamities or Five Disasters]

question: Items in this category that keep absorbing runes and growing are nicknamed the Draconic Series, and their standing is fixed only once they reach the violet stage. The Manoros Clan created it by judging the 999 strongest skills and artifacts across the seven regions. Its top nine entries are called solo, the next ninety double, and the remaining nine hundred triple. Entries at the zero level are also called Skills of Annihilation, and a single one of them can wipe out an entire world. Those skills can be earned only by the transcendent, and holding several of them shatters the soul of anyone who is not. For 10 points, give the term for this ranking of the 999 strongest artifacts and skills across seven regions.

The one in the indigo region is a red jade flame that powers the half-biological armor grown on a moon in the blue region. The green region's consists of a blessing from the Ains that must then be filled by a spirit, since the blessing alone is an empty house. The orange region's is a body enhancement surgery the Akarons devised using the genes of lava-drinking creatures. The red region's is a colossal tree whose branches teleport, whose fruit speeds growth, and whose roots purify poison. A race called the Napa planted each of them to prepare for their own revival, seeding hosts for their waiting souls. For 10 points, give the collective name for these inheritances of vanished races, one left in each colored region, which this series' hero gathers to strengthen humanity.

Light runs along the metal columns it brings, and with a loud grinding sound each of them cracks open into a doorway. Those columns descend from the sky and settle onto holes that have opened in the ground and the air and then stabilized. It begins with a tremor that everyone on the planet feels at once, after which the heavens split and mountain ranges break apart. It marks the opening of the endless pit whose residents then pour through those doorways. In the first timeline it killed everyone who had not yet reached the violet region. For 10 points, name this apocalypse in which metal columns open as gates and the Abyss pours into the world.

Its mastery advances only when its user's body is torn apart and his very self feels close to destruction, so it grows fastest amid varied punishment. Mastering it turns its holder into a transcendent, and its regeneration then matches that of a deathless being. This series' hero won it in the green region as a reward from a fairy for killing Tiamet, and it pairs well with his Demonic Dragon Reinforcement. It was rated the single strongest ability known to humanity, holding the top place in the solo tier. It earned that place partly through the exploits of Kim Kangtae, the strongest human, who charged the front line trusting it to keep healing him. It regrows tissue, mends shattered bodies, and restores lost limbs, letting its user fight with no fear of injury.
